title: Accounting Manager – Remote (Work from anywhere)
description:
Fully remote, no night shifts, no commute - work directly with a US finance team from anywhere in India. This is not a BPO role


MAVI partners with high-growth US startups and SMEs, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly within their finance teams. In India, we are building finance leaders who go beyond execution and take ownership of teams, processes, and client outcomes.


This is not a traditional accounting manager role. You will lead accounting operations for US clients while mentoring and developing your team in a fast-moving environment.


The Opportunity

As an Accounting Manager, you will oversee end-to-end accounting operations for US clients, managing a team of accountants and working directly with US Controllers and CFOs. You will be a key finance partner responsible for accuracy, scalability, and continuous process improvement.


What You Will Own

  • Lead end-to-end accounting (Record-to-Report) for US clients
  • Manage and mentor a team of accountants ensuring quality and professional growth
  • Oversee month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cycles
  • Review and finalize financial statements in compliance with US GAAP
  • Manage multi-location revenue accounting, COGS tracking, and operational expense reconciliations
  • Act as primary US client contact, building strong stakeholder relationships
  • Partner with Controllers and CFOs to support reporting and financial insights
  • Drive process automation and workflow improvements
  • Ensure audit readiness and manage auditor interactions


What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP expertise
  • Prior experience in team management or mentoring
  • Background in hospitality, restaurant tech, or multi-location businesses a strong plus
  • Strong understanding of close cycles, financial reporting, and internal controls
  • ERP experience (NetSuite, Toast, QuickBooks, or similar)
  • CA / CPA (or equivalent) strongly preferred
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to work with US time zone overlap


Why Join MAVI?

  • Lead finance for some of the most exciting US companies
  • Build and manage high-performing accounting teams
  • High ownership and direct visibility with US leadership
  • Fast-track career path to Finance Controller and Head of Finance roles
  • Flexible remote work with global impact
  • Compensation in USD

title: Project Manager
description:
Sobre a Empresa


A SolutionMall é uma plataforma B2B global de produtos profissionais e soluções técnicas integradas. Apoiamos nossos clientes em todo o processo, incluindo levantamento de requisitos, coordenação de soluções, seleção de produtos, coordenação com fornecedores, implementação de projetos e suporte à entrega.


Sobre a Vaga


Estamos procurando um Gerente de Projetos com experiência em instalações de IDC e infraestrutura física de data centers para apoiar a coordenação técnica, implementação e entrega de projetos.

A função abrange sistemas de racks e gabinetes, infraestrutura de energia, sistemas relacionados à refrigeração, cabeamento e outras instalações de suporte em ambientes de IDC e data centers.

Esta é uma oportunidade de cooperação por projeto . O escopo do trabalho, local, cronograma e remuneração serão definidos antes do início de cada projeto.


Responsabilidades


  • Apoiar o levantamento e a definição dos requisitos dos clientes para instalações de data centers
  • Coordenar sistemas de racks e gabinetes, energia, refrigeração, cabeamento e infraestrutura relacionada
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre a infraestrutura física e os equipamentos de servidores, armazenamento e rede
  • Coordenar a comunicação entre clientes, equipes de projeto e equipes técnicas da SolutionMall
  • Apoiar discussões técnicas, esclarecimento de soluções, implementação e entrega de projetos
  • Ajudar a identificar riscos relacionados à preparação da infraestrutura, integração de sistemas e condições do local


Qualificações


  • Experiência em data centers, instalações de IDC ou infraestrutura relacionada
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de racks e gabinetes, energia, refrigeração e infraestrutura de cabeamento
  • Bom conhecimento da infraestrutura física de salas de servidores e data centers
  • Boa capacidade de coordenação técnica e comunicação entre diferentes equipes
  • Inglês fluente


Competências Preferenciais


  • Experiência em projetos de data centers ou instalações de IDC
  • Experiência com implantação de racks e gabinetes ou infraestrutura de suporte
  • Experiência em projetos de data centers modulares ou pré-fabricados


Faixa Salarial e Pacote de Remuneração


Cooperação por projeto. O escopo do trabalho, local, cronograma e remuneração serão definidos antes do início de cada projeto.


Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades


A SolutionMall está comprometida com a diversidade e a inclusão no ambiente de trabalho.


Como se Candidatar


Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn ou envie seu currículo para:

Assunto do e-mail: Candidatura – Gerente de Projetos – Infraestrutura Física de IDC



About the Company


SolutionMall is a global B2B platform for professional products and integrated technical solutions. We support customers through requirement discovery, solution coordination, product selection, supplier coordination, and project implementation and delivery support.


About the Role


We are looking for a Project Manager with experience in IDC facilities and data center physical infrastructure to support technical coordination, project implementation, and delivery. The role covers rack and cabinet systems, supporting power facilities, cooling-related infrastructure, cabling systems, and other supporting hardware facilities inside IDC and data center environments. This is a project-based cooperation opportunity. The work scope, location, schedule, and compensation will be confirmed before each project begins.


Responsibilities


  • Support clarification of customer requirements for data center facilities
  • Coordinate rack and cabinet systems, power, cooling, cabling, and related infrastructure
  • Ensure alignment between infrastructure facilities and servers, storage, and network equipment
  • Coordinate between customers, project teams, and SolutionMall technical teams
  • Support technical discussions, solution clarification, project implementation, and delivery
  • Help identify risks related to infrastructure readiness, system integration, and site conditions


Qualifications


  • Experience in data centers, IDC facilities, or related infrastructure
  • Familiarity with rack and cabinet systems, power, cooling, and cabling infrastructure
  • Good understanding of server room and data center physical facilities
  • Good technical coordination and cross-team communication skills
  • Fluent English


Preferred Skills


  • Experience in data center or IDC facility projects
  • Experience in rack and cabinet deployment or supporting infrastructure
  • Experience in modular or prefabricated data center projects


Pay range and compensation package


Project-based cooperation. The work scope, location, schedule, and compensation will be confirmed before each project begins.


Equal Opportunity Statement


SolutionMall is committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace.


How to Apply


Apply through LinkedIn or send your resume to:


Email subject: Application – Project Manager – IDC Hardware Facilities

title: English Teacher | Professor(a) de Inglês — Remoto
description:
A FLIPT English está em busca de 2 English Teachers para fazer parte do nosso time, com possibilidade de inclusão em um banco de reserva para futuras contratações.


Acreditamos que aprender inglês pode ser uma experiência mais leve, humana e possível. Por isso, buscamos professores que unam qualidade educacional, clareza e acolhimento, ajudando adultos a superar bloqueios, recuperar a confiança e viver o idioma de forma prática.


RESPONSABILIDADES

Você conduzirá aulas individuais e em grupo para adultos, trabalhando conteúdos de inglês geral, Business English e preparação para exames de proficiência.


Será responsável por conduzir aulas on-line com clareza, dinamismo e foco em situações reais de comunicação, acompanhar o desenvolvimento dos alunos e contribuir para uma experiência de aprendizagem positiva, profissional e acolhedora.


A agenda terá flexibilidade: você disponibilizará seus horários no Calendly, e os alunos realizarão os agendamentos de acordo com essa disponibilidade. É indispensável ter disponibilidade para atuar em turnos da noite.


REQUISITOS

  • Experiência prévia com ensino de inglês na modalidade on-line.
  • Certificação de proficiência em inglês (TOEFL, IELTS ou exame compatível).
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em turnos da noite.
  • Organização e autonomia para trabalhar com uma agenda flexível no Calendly.
  • Boa comunicação e compromisso com uma experiência de aprendizagem acolhedora, prática e profissional.


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Experiência com preparação de alunos para os exames TOEFL, IELTS ou CAE.
  • Experiência com aulas para adultos.


O QUE A FLIPT OFERECE

  • A contratação será PJ, com possibilidade de atuação de até 20 horas semanais .
  • Durante o primeiro mês, período de treinamento inicial, o valor será de R$ 30 por hora . Após essa etapa, o valor da hora será aberto à negociação .
  • A oportunidade também inclui porcentagem sobre indicações e participação nos lucros , conforme os critérios definidos pela FLIPT.


COMO SE CANDIDATAR

  • Envie seu currículo para com o assunto “Vaga English Teacher — FLIPT”.
  • No corpo do e-mail, conte brevemente sobre sua experiência com aulas on-line, sua certificação de proficiência e sua disponibilidade semanal, especialmente no período noturno.

title: Organizational Change Management Lead
description:
OCM Lead (Portuguese Speaking) - 6 Month Contract


Location: Brazil (Remote/Hybrid)

Industry: Pharmaceutical


We are seeking an experienced Organizational Change Management (OCM) Lead to support a major transformation programme within a global pharmaceutical organisation. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the Change Management strategy and execution across the ACC region, ensuring successful adoption of new processes, systems, and ways of working.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of Organizational Change Management activities across the ACC region.
  • Develop and manage detailed OCM plans (Level 3+), aligned with programme milestones and business objectives.
  • Execute core OCM deliverables including stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, communications, training, and readiness activities.
  • Provide weekly status reporting on OCM progress, risks, issues, and key milestones.
  • Identify, manage, and mitigate regional change risks while supporting local country teams with their change challenges.
  • Collaborate closely with Regional Americas and Global OCM teams to ensure alignment with overall change strategy and methodology.
  • Support business leaders and stakeholders throughout the transformation lifecycle to drive user adoption and business readiness.


Required Experience

  • Proven experience leading Organizational Change Management initiatives within large-scale transformation programmes.
  • Strong understanding of OCM methodologies (Prosci, ADKAR, or equivalent).
  • Experience in stakeholder management, communications planning, change impact assessments, and organisational readiness.
  • Ability to work across multiple countries and cultures in a regional environment.
  • Previous pharmaceutical, life sciences, or highly regulated industry experience preferred.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English are essential. Spanish is advantageous.


Contract Details

  • Duration: 6 Months
  • Location: Brazil
  • Start: ASAP


This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned Change Management professional to support a strategic transformation programme within a leading global pharmaceutical company.

title: Recruiter/ Onboarder
description:
Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours.

This is not your usual job post. Instead of the classic recruiter ad filled with words like “dynamic,” “self-starter,” and “people person,” I thought I’d simply share the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Recruiter & Onboarder with Go! Running Tours.


Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one.


So, let’s start.


Our new Recruiter/Onboarder will be responsible for finding, selecting, and onboard the incredible running guides who make Go! Running Tours what it is today.


You should get a kick out of owning the entire process from identifying candidates to bringing them to the finish line. We are not looking for quick fix recruiters, but for that one person who is able to recruit colleagues who will work with us for the next 5, 10, 15 years. Because truly good colleagues are hard to come by and even harder to let go 😊.


In the team, we have everything from bike messengers to professors, from a young and fast 22-year-old, to an even faster retiree (sub 3 marathon type of retiree ). Your job will be to identify these candidates, bring them on board, and assist them in the early steps of their journey and ensure the quality of our tours.


The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself. But the most important skills of all are: execution and persistency (not the annoying type, but the type that brings you to the finish line of a marathon). And this is likely where the “ugly” comes in, because our colleagues have different backgrounds, different personalities and different lives outside Go! Running Tours. That means that some of our colleagues complete the onboarding and associated tasks without blinking and to perfection, while others may need more support and follow-up to reach the finish line. 


You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that \"makes sense\" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world — and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!


Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!


We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for interviews and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world 😉.


The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you - running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should. 


The contract details are as follows:

Contract details are as follows:

10 hrs/week

USD 12/hr + bonus

Managed via upwork


That’s it, I think. I’ve probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea.


If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via with a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version 😉).


All the best and happy running,

Lena

title: Recruiter/ Onboarder
description:
Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours.

This is not your usual job post. Instead of the classic recruiter ad filled with words like “dynamic,” “self-starter,” and “people person,” I thought I’d simply share the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Recruiter & Onboarder with Go! Running Tours.


Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one.


So, let’s start.


Our new Recruiter/Onboarder will be responsible for finding, selecting, and onboard the incredible running guides who make Go! Running Tours what it is today.


You should get a kick out of owning the entire process from identifying candidates to bringing them to the finish line. We are not looking for quick fix recruiters, but for that one person who is able to recruit colleagues who will work with us for the next 5, 10, 15 years. Because truly good colleagues are hard to come by and even harder to let go 😊.


In the team, we have everything from bike messengers to professors, from a young and fast 22-year-old, to an even faster retiree (sub 3 marathon type of retiree ). Your job will be to identify these candidates, bring them on board, and assist them in the early steps of their journey and ensure the quality of our tours.


The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself. But the most important skills of all are: execution and persistency (not the annoying type, but the type that brings you to the finish line of a marathon). And this is likely where the “ugly” comes in, because our colleagues have different backgrounds, different personalities and different lives outside Go! Running Tours. That means that some of our colleagues complete the onboarding and associated tasks without blinking and to perfection, while others may need more support and follow-up to reach the finish line. 


You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that \"makes sense\" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world — and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!


Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!


We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for interviews and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world 😉.


The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you - running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should. 


The contract details are as follows:

Contract details are as follows:

10 hrs/week

USD 12/hr + bonus

Managed via upwork


That’s it, I think. I’ve probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea.


If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via with a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version 😉).


All the best and happy running,

Lena

title: BIM Modeler
description:
BIM Modeler – Fire Protection / Sprinkler Systems (US Projects) | Revit MEP | 100% Remote LATAM

100% REMOTE OPPORTUNITY FOR LATAM AEC PROFESSIONALS!

Work directly with leading US-based engineering & construction firms.


Competitive Pay in USD | Full-Time (NY Schedule) | 100% Remote (Brazil)


We are hiring a BIM Modeler / Specialist focused on Fire Protection & Sprinkler Systems to join the design team of one of our U.S.-based construction clients in New York.

In this role, you will work directly with the client’s engineering team to develop detailed fire sprinkler shop drawings, build 3D models using Revit MEP and AutoSprink, and ensure full compliance with NFPA standards. This is an ideal position for Mechanical, Civil, Sanitary, or Fire Protection Engineers with hands-on experience in fire protection design (RCI/PCI) and BIM coordination.


What We Offer

  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in LATAM directly for a U.S. client.
  • USD Compensation: Competitive rate with direct international payment.
  • Full-Time: Monday–Friday (New York / EST Schedule).
  • 18 PTO Days: Flexible paid time off for personal use.
  • Professional Growth: Direct exposure to U.S. building codes, NFPA standards, and advanced BIM workflows.


What You’ll Do

  • Develop detailed 3D models and construction-ready shop drawings using Revit MEP and AutoSprink .
  • Design, model, and coordinate fire sprinkler and fire suppression systems for commercial and residential U.S. projects.
  • Apply NFPA standards (particularly NFPA 13, 14 & 20) to develop fully compliant, constructible designs.
  • Perform clash detection and spatial coordination with Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Structural disciplines using Navisworks .
  • Proactively review plans to identify design conflicts and develop practical engineering solutions before construction.
  • Conduct QA/QC reviews to eliminate modeling errors and maintain organized project documentation/revisions.


What You’ll Bring

  • English Level: Advanced Technical & Conversational English (B2+ / C1).
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in fire protection design, fire sprinkler modeling, or RCI/PCI systems.
  • Core Software: Expert proficiency in Revit MEP (mandatory); strong experience with AutoSprink is highly preferred.
  • US Standards: Deep knowledge of NFPA standards (NFPA 13) and U.S. fire protection practices.
  • Education: Degree in Mechanical, Civil, Sanitary, or Fire Protection Engineering, Architecture, or equivalent practical design experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong technical background with high attention to detail and ability to work independently.


Tools & Key Skills

  • Tools: Revit MEP • AutoSprink • Navisworks • AutoCAD
  • Technical Areas: Fire Sprinkler Design • Fire Protection Systems • RCI / PCI • NFPA 13 • BIM Modeling • MEP Coordination • Shop Drawings • Clash Detection


Similar Search Terms / Target Profiles

BIM Modeler • Fire Protection BIM Designer • Fire Sprinkler Specialist • Revit MEP Designer – Fire Protection • Ingeniero RCI / PCI • Diseñador de Sistemas Contra Incendios • Fire Protection Engineer • Sprinkler Designer


About Cresta

At Cresta, we connect top AEC professionals across Latin America with leading engineering and construction companies in the U.S. You will work as a dedicated, full-time member of our client's team, collaborating directly on real-world U.S. projects while Cresta supports your ongoing onboarding and HR experience.


Ready to model safer projects for the US market? Apply now and elevate your career!

Note: Only CVs submitted in English will be reviewed.

title: Crypto Operations Specialist
description:
About us

Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do

  • Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts.
  • Work with non-custodial wallets (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum.
  • Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets.
  • Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out.
  • Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed.
  • Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team.
  • Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage.
  • Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem.
  • Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here.
  • Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.

What we are looking for

  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side.
  • Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong.
  • Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits.
  • Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals.
  • Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit.
  • Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did.
  • Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support.
  • Stable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have

  • Experience with DeFi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar.
  • Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange.
  • Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.

What the role offers

  • Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year
  • Paid vacation
  • Full medical insurance
  • Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered
  • Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company
  • Budget for professional courses and certifications
  • Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do

  • Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts.
  • Work with non-custodial wallets (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum.
  • Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets.
  • Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out.
  • Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed.
  • Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team.
  • Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage.
  • Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem.
  • Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here.
  • Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.

What we are looking for

  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side.
  • Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong.
  • Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits.
  • Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals.
  • Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit.
  • Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did.
  • Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support.
  • Stable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have

  • Experience with DeFi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar.
  • Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange.
  • Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.

What the role offers

  • Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year
  • Paid vacation
  • Full medical insurance
  • Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered
  • Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company
  • Budget for professional courses and certifications
  • Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: ESPECIALISTA DE DADOS
description:
Cargo: ESPECIALISTA DE DADOS


Já pensou em trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas de Tecnologia do Brasil?

Então a CAST é o lugar certo para você! 😉


Todas as nossas vagas são afirmativas 🦼✊ 🤱 ️ !!!


Local de Atuação: Brasil

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto


O QUE BUSCAMOS

Estamos em busca de um profissional responsável por projetar, implantar e operar a infraestrutura de nuvem que sustenta a plataforma de dados, garantindo conectividade, identidade, armazenamento, criptografia, disponibilidade, observabilidade e controle de custos, com atuação em ambientes híbridos AWS e on-premises.


Que possua conhecimentos e experiências em:

✔️ Domínio de fundamentos AWS, incluindo redes, IAM, armazenamento, criptografia, monitoramento, alta disponibilidade, backup e recuperação;

✔️ Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), preferencialmente Terraform, gestão de estado, módulos reutilizáveis e pipelines de mudanças;

✔️ Conhecimentos sólidos de TCP/IP, DNS, roteamento, firewalls, proxies, balanceadores, VPN/Direct Connect e troubleshooting de conectividade;

✔️ Experiência com práticas de segurança em nuvem, incluindo menor privilégio, segregação de funções, gestão de segredos, rotação de credenciais e hardening;

✔️ Administração de ambientes AWS utilizados pelo Databricks, incluindo VPCs, subnets, security groups, S3, IAM Roles, KMS, PrivateLink e endpoints privados;

✔️ Experiência com automação de provisionamento de workspaces e recursos compartilhados utilizando Terraform, com separação por órgão e ambiente;

✔️ Conhecimento em conectividade híbrida com bancos Oracle e outros serviços on-premises, incluindo proxies, rotas, resolução de nomes e monitoramento de disponibilidade;

✔️ Experiência na gestão de credenciais e identidades técnicas utilizadas por pipelines, service principals e integrações entre Azure DevOps, Databricks e AWS;

✔️ Conhecimento em observabilidade de infraestrutura, incluindo alertas, logs, métricas e runbooks de resposta;

✔️ Conhecimento em FinOps, incluindo tagging, budgets, análise de consumo, right-sizing e identificação de desperdícios em computação, armazenamento e tráfego;

✔️ Experiência ou conhecimento em migração de componentes on-premises e Kubernetes/Rancher para serviços em nuvem, garantindo continuidade e segurança.


BENEFÍCIOS PARA TODOS

Recarregue suas energias com o auxílio-alimentação.

🚘 Facilitamos seu caminho para o trabalho com o vale-transporte.

🚑 Cuidar de você é nosso compromisso: plano de saúde para sua tranquilidade.

Cuidar de quem cuida é essencial! Com o Programa Baby CAST, nossas mamães recebem um Kit Maternidade CASTLOVERS, preparado com carinho para celebrar a chegada do bebê. (Benefício disponível para vagas elegíveis.)


BENEFÍCIOS PARA VOCÊ ESCOLHER

🦷 Sorria com confiança: nosso plano odontológico cuida do seu bem-estar bucal.

⚕️ Cuide da sua saúde com mais praticidade: com o Dr. Alper, você tem acesso a teleconsultas sem coparticipação, cashback na compra de medicamentos e mapeamento de saúde.

🩺 Com o Starbem, você e até quatro dependentes contam com teleconsultas gratuitas com psicólogos, nutricionistas, clínico geral e médicos especialistas.

️ ♀️ Transforme seu bem-estar: com Wellhub, você tem acesso a academias e atividades físicas em todo lugar.

🧠 Seu bem-estar mental é nossa prioridade: apoio psicológico disponível.

Seja seu melhor com nossas iniciativas de bem-estar. Nos escritórios da CAST, disponibilizamos frutas para tornar a rotina mais leve e saudável.

Aproveite nosso crédito consignado para realizar seus sonhos com segurança e praticidade.

Com o Clube de Descontos economize mais com nossos descontos exclusivos para colaboradores.


E TEM MAIS! DESENVOLVA SUA CARREIRA

Temos a CAST Academy recheada de cursos on-line, e parcerias educacionais para cursos de Graduação e Idiomas (United Idiomas) com super descontos.


E aí, topa ser um #CASTLOVER ?

title: Email Marketing Designer
description:
Email Marketing Designer

Full-Time | 40 hrs/week | Remote and US business hours | Long-Term Contract


About the Role

Our client, a high-growth, 8-figure DTC apparel brand, is looking for a highly experienced Graphic Designer to join their email marketing and paid-ads creative team full-time. This role plays a key part in executing high-frequency campaigns that reflect the brand's voice and drive results across email and paid channels.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-quality email graphics and layouts in Figma, aligned with campaign objectives
  • Translate monthly marketing briefs into compelling visual executions
  • Prepare and integrate final designs into Klaviyo for email campaign flows
  • Work closely with the email marketing team to execute lifecycle campaigns
  • Ensure visuals reflect brand voice and customer nuance
  • Support paid media creative assets
  • Support social media graphics and promotional assets
  • Contribute to creative execution for product launches and seasonal campaigns
  • Execute quickly and efficiently in a high-frequency campaign environment
  • Apply strategic thinking to every email — including CTA hierarchy, personalization, and urgency — not just visual execution
  • Own the full range of lifecycle email types: welcome/onboarding, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, cross-sell, and win-back


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional graphic design experience, with a strong focus on email marketing or lifecycle campaigns
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma (primary design tool for this role)
  • Strong attention to detail and brand alignment
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven DTC environment
  • Ability to collaborate closely with lifecycle/email marketing teams
  • Strong execution discipline, consistency, and speed of delivery
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce email marketing strategy (CTA hierarchy, personalization, urgency, friction reduction) — not purely visual design
  • Experience supporting eCommerce brands at scale, ideally $500K+ in monthly revenue
  • Fluent English communication (written and verbal) for daily collaboration with a US-based team


Nice to Have

  • Experience preparing and integrating designs into Klaviyo
  • Familiarity with Canva as a secondary design tool


Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a seasoned designer with deep, hands-on experience creating high-quality email marketing creatives — not a generalist. They work confidently in Figma, understand how their designs flow into email platforms like Klaviyo, and take ownership of their output from concept to final asset. They're comfortable juggling multiple campaigns at once and thrive in the rhythm of a fast-paced DTC brand.

title: Director of Strategic Partnerships
description:
ABOUT ELIFE

Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, FinTechs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.


THE ROLE

We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.

This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding
  • Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform
  • Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time
  • Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries
  • Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM
  • Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships


WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise partnerships experience
  • Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM
  • Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets
  • Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end
  • Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, DiDi, MercadoPago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, iFood or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks
  • Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus
  • Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required
  • Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

title: Team Leader de Tecnologia - REMOTO
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


🚀 Oportunidade: Team Leader de Tecnologia


Modelo: Remoto


Desafios do Perfil (Atribuições):

Principais Responsabilidades

Acompanhar as atividades diárias das equipes envolvidas no escopo dos projetos e serviços.

Atuar na identificação, remoção e escalonamento de impedimentos que possam impactar a produtividade ou as entregas.

Coordenar dependências entre equipes, fornecedores e áreas parceiras.

Garantir o alinhamento operacional entre os diferentes times participantes das iniciativas.

Facilitar a comunicação entre equipes técnicas, áreas de negócio e stakeholders envolvidos.

Conduzir reuniões de acompanhamento, alinhamento e status das atividades.

Monitorar a evolução das entregas e acompanhar o cumprimento dos compromissos assumidos.

Garantir a aplicação dos processos, fluxos operacionais e padrões de qualidade definidos.

Apoiar a gestão de prioridades em conjunto com as lideranças e responsáveis pelas demandas.

Identificar riscos operacionais e promover ações preventivas ou corretivas.

Acompanhar indicadores de produtividade, qualidade, eficiência operacional e evolução das entregas.

Promover a colaboração entre as equipes e incentivar a cultura de melhoria contínua.

Atuar como ponto focal para coordenação operacional das atividades sob sua responsabilidade.


Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)


Obrigatórios

Experiência na coordenação operacional de equipes multidisciplinares em ambientes corporativos.

Vivência em projetos ou operações de Tecnologia da Informação.

Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum, Kanban ou modelos híbridos.

Experiência no acompanhamento de demandas, atividades e entregas.

Conhecimento em gestão de dependências entre equipes e múltiplas frentes de trabalho.

Experiência na condução de reuniões de acompanhamento e alinhamento operacional.

Conhecimento de indicadores de produtividade, desempenho e qualidade.

Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de atividades e colaboração corporativa.

Capacidade de identificar riscos, gargalos e impedimentos operacionais, promovendo sua resolução ou escalonamento.


Desejáveis

Experiência em ambientes com equipes distribuídas, multidisciplinares e compostas por profissionais internos e terceiros.

Vivência em operações de sustentação, projetos de transformação digital ou modernização tecnológica.

Conhecimento em processos ITIL e governança operacional.

Experiência com gestão de serviços de TI.

Familiaridade com frameworks de escalabilidade ágil.

Certificações Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, ITIL ou correlatas.


Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


Coordenação e Influência

Capacidade de mobilizar equipes em torno de objetivos comuns.

Influência sem autoridade hierárquica direta.

Habilidade para conduzir alinhamentos entre diferentes áreas.

Capacidade de negociação e construção de consenso.


Comunicação e Relacionamento

Comunicação clara, objetiva e assertiva.

Escuta ativa.

Facilidade de relacionamento interpessoal.

Capacidade de mediação de conflitos.

Habilidade para atuar com múltiplos stakeholders simultaneamente.


Organização e Execução

Forte capacidade de planejamento e acompanhamento.

Organização e gestão de prioridades.

Senso de urgência.

Capacidade de atuar sob pressão e com múltiplas demandas.

Visão sistêmica para identificação de impactos e dependências.


Perfil Profissional

Forte orientação para resultados.

Proatividade.

Resiliência.

Responsabilidade e comprometimento.

Capacidade analítica.

Foco na solução de problemas.

Mentalidade colaborativa.

Adaptabilidade a ambientes dinâmicos.

Compromisso com qualidade e excelência operacional.


Formação Acadêmica

Ensino Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.


Hard Skills:

• Gestão de backlog e demandas (Senior)

• Coordenação de equipes multidisciplinares (Senior)

• Gestão de dependências entre times (Senior)

• Metodologias Ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) (Senior)

• Gestão de serviços de TI (ITIL) (Senior)


🤝 Soft Skills:

• Comunicação clara, objetiva e assertiva (Avançado)

• Capacidade de articulação entre áreas técnicas e de negócio (Avançado)

• Organização e gestão de prioridades (Avançado)

• Capacidade analítica (Avançado)


🧭 Metodologias:

• Adoção de práticas de desenvolvimento ágil (Avançado )


Domínios de Negócio:

• Banco 24 Horas (Intermediário)


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!


Assistência médica;

VR e VA flexível;

Gympass e Wellz;

Parceria com o SESC;

Descontos em restaurantes;

Descontos em cursos técnicos e de ensinos superior;

Descontos em escolas e plataformas de idiomas.


E aí, aceita o desafio? Então conclua sua candidatura e #VemSerFoursys! Boa sorte!

title: AI Content Developer
description:
🚀 AI Content Developer | Brazil

At LTM , a global technology consulting and digital solutions company, we empower enterprises to accelerate innovation and drive business transformation. We are currently looking for an AI Content Developer to join a leading global consumer products organization and help shape the future of AI-powered content creation.


Role Overview

We are seeking a creative and innovative AI Content Developer with strong experience in Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, and Multimedia Content Creation . This role will be responsible for developing engaging digital assets across text, image, video, and audio formats while ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and business objectives.


Key Responsibilities

✅ Create and edit multimedia content using AI and traditional creative tools.

✅ Develop high-quality assets leveraging platforms such as Midjourney, Google Veo, RunwayML , and Adobe Creative Suite tools including Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and After Effects .

✅ Design and optimize prompts to improve the quality, consistency, factual accuracy, and tone of AI-generated content.

✅ Collaborate with global stakeholders to understand content requirements and deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.

✅ Ensure all content aligns with established brand standards and user experience expectations.

✅ Stay up to date with emerging trends in Generative AI, digital media, and content innovation.

✅ Required Qualifications

• 6-10 years of experience in content development, digital media, creative production, or related areas.

• Hands-on experience with Generative AI tools for content creation.

• Strong expertise in Prompt Engineering and AI content workflows.

• Experience creating content across image, video, audio, and text formats .

• Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite tools.

• Strong creative judgment with the ability to distinguish high-quality content and visual storytelling.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Location

Brazil (Remote/Hybrid, depending on business requirements)


Interested?

If you're passionate about the intersection of Creativity, AI, and Digital Innovation , we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or send your CV to explore this exciting opportunity.

description:

Tenha espaço para crescer na sua carreira, venha fazer parte da empresa que mais entrega resultado em gestão de tráfego pago e escala de negócios no digital: o Grupo Ápice34!


●   Aprenda muito mais e assuma desafios na área promissora de gestão de tráfego pago, se desenvolva e cresça profissionalmente;


●   Remuneração variável de acordo com o sucesso nos seus projetos;


●   Temos um plano de carreira acelerado, baseado em meritocracia e plano de desenvolvimento individual para as próximas etapas da sua carreira;


●   100% Remoto.


●   Contrato PJ com alta demanda . Contrato sem exclusividade, porém dificilmente você vai conseguir conciliar o nosso contrato com mais de 2 projetos autônomos pequenos em paralelo. Não aceitamos candidatos que, simultaneamente, querem conciliar a nossa prestação de serviços com a prestação de serviços para outras agências, pois a nossa demanda é muito alta e os nossos gestores são de alta performance. Foco é o caminho para a alta performance.


-> Se inscreva e veja mais sobre nós no nosso site:


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES OBRIGATÓRIAS:

  • Experiência de no mínimo 2 anos práticos fazendo gestão de tráfego pago;
  • Conhecimento hands-on avançado em gestão de tráfego pago (planejamento, estratégia, criação e otimização de campanhas) no Facebook Ads e Google Ads com pelo menos 200 mil investidos;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Google Sheets e Excel;
  • Conhecimento avançado em coleta e análise de dados (Configurações de rastreamento, interpretação de métricas, pixels, tags etc);
  • Noções de LGPD e boas práticas de segurança da informação;
  • Diferencial: Familiaridade com ClickUp ou outra ferramenta de gestão de projetos;
  • Idiomas: desejável inglês intermediário 
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara;
  • Pensamento analítico;
  • Proatividade e busca pela excelência;
  • Organização e disciplina;
  • Senso de responsabilidade.


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES A SEREM DESENVOLVIDAS / RESPONSABILIDADES A SEREM DESENVOLVIDAS: 

  • Criar estratégias de gestão de tráfego pago para clientes;
  • Criar campanhas de tráfego pago;
  • Comunicação periódica em grupos com os clientes e suas equipes, a fim de sugerir otimizações e planos de ação para escalar os projetos de forma holística;
  • Executar setup de traqueamento das campanhas de tráfego em todas as plataformas (Analytics, GTM, Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Hotmart Analytics, TikTok Ads, etc...);
  • Configuração dos BMs e Contas de Anúncios dos parceiros;
  • Checagem regular da conformidade dos Anúncios (configuração das campanhas, copy anúncios, setup completo);
  • Criação de Relatórios e Dashboards internos e externos (para clientes);
  • Acompanhamento do \"valor investido VS ROAS\" de todas as campanhas no Squad, buscando maximizar a lucratividade;
  • Avaliar tráfego orgânico, estratégia de vendas, páginas, criativos, copies, posicionamentos, etc;
  • Executa e conduz a preparação de debriefings;
  • Gestão e execução de Onboarding de novos parceiros;
  • Organizar e centralizar informações na plataforma ClickUp;
  • Suporte proativo a outros colaboradores em Campanhas e estratégias de gestão de tráfego complexas, aplicando os conceitos do Método CSS e buscando a maximização dos resultados.


BENEFÍCIOS:

●    Plano de carreira bem definido, que proporciona visão de longo prazo;

●    Remuneração variável de acordo com o sucesso nos seus projetos;

●   Bonificação com dias off;

●   Acesso à treinamentos;

●   Bonificações e premiações por performance;

●   Feedbacks individuais regulares;

●   Plano de desenvolvimento individual;

●   Cultura que valoriza o bem-estar das pessoas;


Venha fazer parte do time de escaladores de negócios de alta performance!

Nós trabalhamos pelo propósito de levar produtos transformadores ao alcance de mais pessoas. Atendemos empresas de diversos segmentos: E-commerces, infoprodutores e empresas B2B ou B2C que estão buscando crescer e vender mais no digital. Já são 5 anos de história e queremos continuá-la com você!

title: BIM Manager
description:
BIM Manager – Archicad Super User


We’re looking for a highly experienced BIM Manager / Archicad Super User with 10+ years of experience to lead BIM workflows, Archicad template improvements, model coordination, and project standards for international architectural projects.


This role is ideal for someone with deep hands-on Archicad expertise who can guide teams, improve BIM processes, and ensure high-quality project delivery.


What you’ll do

  • Set up and manage Archicad template and project files, teamwork environments.
  • Review and coordinate BIM models to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with project standards.
  • Support architects and project teams with complex modeling, documentation, and coordination issues.
  • Lead BIM coordination workflows, including IFC exchange, model federation, clash review, and issue tracking.
  • Improve internal BIM standards, workflows, and best practices for Archicad-based projects.
  • Train and mentor team members to work efficiently and consistently in Archicad.


What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years of experience, at least 5 years modeling in Archicad and at least 2 years as BIM Manager
  • Archicad Super User with advanced hands-on expertise.
  • Strong background in BIM coordination, model management, documentation, and project standards.
  • Knowledge of openBIM, IFC workflows, clash coordination, and multidisciplinary collaboration.
  • Ability to lead, train, and support project teams.
  • C1 English level or higher , both written and spoken.
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.


Role: BIM Manager – Archicad Super User

Experience: 10+ years

English: C1+

Software: Archicad advanced / super user level

title: Media Buyer + Strategist - Affiliate Marketing - Competitive Salary + Commission
description:
We’re hiring a senior media buyer with a strong creative strategy background to lead growth across two of our core verticals.


This person will own budget scaling, performance decisions, and creative direction—writing scripts and collaborating with editors to develop winning ads.


This isn’t a role where you’ll simply hand off ideas. You’ll take responsibility for the full creative process—from research and concept development through production, testing, iteration, and scaling.


You’ll work closely with our video editors and media buyers to turn customer insights and performance data into ads that drive measurable growth. Essentially, you would handle the creative direction and have a team that would create the ads, launch them, and perform a lot of the day to day operations so you can focus on the higher level strategy.


What you’ll own:

• Lead creative strategy across two distinct verticals

• Conduct competitor, market, customer, and ad-library research

• Develop fresh angles, hooks, offers, and advertising concepts

• Write direct-response scripts and detailed creative briefs

• Guide video editors from initial concept through final delivery

• Collaborate with media buyers on testing plans and performance analysis

• Identify winning creatives and develop new iterations to extend their lifespan

• Build a repeatable creative system that consistently produces new tests

• Scale winning campaigns within your verticals, cut losers, etc


You could be a great fit if you:

• Have experience developing performance creative for paid social

• Are a strong direct-response writer and understand what makes people take action

• Can interpret metrics such as CPA, CPL, ROAS, CTR, and hook or hold rates

• Know how to turn research and data into compelling creative ideas

• Communicate clearly with editors, media buyers, and leadership

• Balance strategic thinking with fast, consistent execution

• Take ownership of results and are comfortable being measured against performance

• Are constantly studying ads, markets, customers, and emerging creative trends

  • A definite plus if you've worked as a performance affiliate marketer in the past


What we offer:

• Competitive base compensation

• Performance-based commission

• Ownership of two important growth verticals

• Direct influence over strategy, production, and account growth

• The opportunity to build and lead a creative engine—not simply contribute to one


To apply, send us:

  • Please make a joke about a fruit so I know you read the job post
  • Share some work history that is relevant, maybe a brief summary of your framework for testing winning ads, how you come up with new angles to test, and any wins you've had in the past few years
  • Let's get on a call to see if it's a good fit. I want to give a week trial to 5-6 applicants

title: Desenvolvedor Back-end Java/Kotlin - Especialista
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos responsáveis por construir e evoluir plataformas de engenharia que suportam soluções de IA em escala, atuando em camadas críticas de backend, BFFs e hubs de comunicação. Nosso foco está em arquiteturas resilientes, escaláveis e seguras, que sustentam produtos estratégicos e aceleram a adoção de IA no banco. Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em Desenvolvimento Backend com foco em Kotlin , com forte maturidade técnica e capacidade de influenciar decisões arquiteturais de médio e longo prazo. Essa posição tem impacto direto na evolução das plataformas de AI Engineering e atua de forma transversal com diferentes times de tecnologia.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

• Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas complexas, atuando de ponta a ponta no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software, da concepção arquitetural ao deploy e operação em produção.

• Ser referência técnica para o time e para outras squads, garantindo padrões elevados de qualidade, performance, segurança e resiliência em serviços como BFFs, comm-hubs e APIs estratégicas.

• Definir e evoluir arquiteturas backend, avaliando trade-offs técnicos, riscos operacionais e impactos de longo prazo nas plataformas de AI Engineering.

• Estabelecer e disseminar boas práticas de engenharia, incluindo TDD/BDD, clean code, DDD, code reviews estruturados e alta cobertura de testes automatizados.

• Atuar fortemente na operação e sustentação dos sistemas em produção, com foco em observabilidade, análise de causa raiz, prevenção de incidentes e melhoria contínua.

• Influenciar decisões técnicas junto a produto, dados, plataforma e arquitetura, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas escaláveis e sustentáveis.

• Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico de engenheiros do time, promovendo evolução de competências e maturidade em engenharia de software.


Requisitos e qualificações

• Experiência avançada e comprovada em desenvolvimento backend com Kotlin ou Java, utilizando frameworks como Spring Boot em ambientes de alta escala.

• Forte domínio em arquitetura de microsserviços e BFFs, incluindo versionamento de APIs, padrões de integração, resiliência, escalabilidade e comunicação assíncrona.

• Experiência sólida com automação de testes em múltiplos níveis (unitários, integração, contrato), garantindo confiabilidade e segurança nas entregas.

• Conhecimento aprofundado em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como PostgreSQL, MongoDB e Cassandra, com foco em consistência, performance e disponibilidade.

• Vivência robusta com sistemas de mensageria e streaming, como Kafka, SQS e SNS, em cenários de alta volumetria.

• Domínio de práticas de observabilidade, incluindo métricas, logs estruturados, tracing distribuído e definição de SLIs/SLOs.

• Experiência prática em ambientes Cloud (preferencialmente AWS), com uso de infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou CloudFormation) e pipelines de CI/CD maduros.

• Conhecimento avançado em segurança de aplicações, incluindo autenticação e autorização (JWT, OAuth2), criptografia e práticas de secure by design.

• Atuação consistente em ambientes ágeis, com mentalidade DevOps, ownership técnico e foco em eficiência operacional.

• Experiência prévia em plataformas complexas, integração entre sistemas ou produtos digitais de missão crítica.

title: Desenvolvedor de Agentes Corporativos Pleno
description:
Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Agentes Corporativos Pleno para atuar em um projeto estratégico de uma seguradora multinacional dos Estados Unidos.


A posição tem como principal desafio construir, evoluir e integrar agentes corporativos utilizando Microsoft Copilot Studio, conectando inteligência artificial aos processos e sistemas do negócio.


Buscamos alguém com experiência prática e comprovada em Microsoft Copilot Studio, que tenha perfil hands-on, visão de integração e interesse em transformar assistentes conversacionais em agentes capazes de executar processos de negócio.


Principais desafios

Construir e evoluir agentes corporativos utilizando Microsoft Copilot Studio.

Implementar soluções de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) utilizando SharePoint, Microsoft Graph e bases de conhecimento corporativas.

Integrar agentes a sistemas internos por meio de APIs, Power Automate e serviços Azure.

Evoluir assistentes conversacionais para agentes capazes de executar processos e apoiar jornadas de negócio.

Criar estratégias de prompting, grounding e controle de alucinações.

Garantir aspectos de governança, segurança, privacidade e Responsible AI.

Atuar desde a concepção da solução até sua implantação e geração de valor para o negócio.


Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento de Agentes

Construção, configuração e evolução de agentes no Microsoft Copilot Studio.

Criação e otimização de prompts, tópicos, instruções e estratégias de grounding.

Configuração e integração de fontes de conhecimento corporativas.

Desenvolvimento de automações utilizando Power Automate.

Publicação, gerenciamento e evolução de agentes nos canais Microsoft.

Arquitetura e Integração

Integração de agentes com APIs, Azure, Microsoft Graph e sistemas corporativos.

Utilização de Dataverse e recursos da Power Platform.

Definição de mecanismos de autenticação, autorização e controles de acesso.

Desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis, seguras e reutilizáveis.

Participação na definição de arquitetura e desenho das soluções de agentes.

Governança e Segurança

Participação em avaliações de arquitetura, privacidade e riscos relacionados às soluções de IA.

Aplicação e acompanhamento de políticas de DLP (Data Loss Prevention).

Gestão de acessos e permissões utilizando Microsoft Entra ID.

Aplicação de boas práticas de segurança, governança e Responsible AI.


Requisitos obrigatórios

Experiência prática e comprovada com Microsoft Copilot Studio.

Experiência recente com desenvolvimento de agentes corporativos.

Conhecimento de Power Automate.

Conhecimento de Dataverse e Power Platform.

Conhecimento de APIs REST, JSON e OAuth.

Conhecimento de Microsoft Graph.

Conhecimento de Azure e Microsoft 365.

Experiência com Prompt Engineering.

Conhecimento prático de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).

Conhecimento de Grounding e estratégias para redução de alucinações em soluções de IA.

Importante: buscamos profissionais com experiência efetivamente prática em Microsoft Copilot Studio, e não apenas conhecimento conceitual ou experiência genérica com ferramentas de IA.


Será considerado diferencial

Conhecimento ou experiência com MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Experiência com arquiteturas multiagente.

Conhecimento de orquestração de agentes.

Experiência com Azure AI Foundry.

Experiência com métricas de adoção, eficiência e geração de valor de agentes corporativos.

Experiência em ambientes corporativos de grande porte e/ou empresas multinacionais.

A posição requer experiência prática e recente com Microsoft Copilot Studio, considerando a evolução e disponibilidade da plataforma a partir de 2024.


O que buscamos


Uma pessoa com perfil hands-on, curiosa e orientada à solução, que consiga transitar entre tecnologia, inteligência artificial e necessidades do negócio.

Mais do que construir um chatbot, queremos alguém capaz de pensar em agentes que utilizem conhecimento corporativo, interajam com sistemas e APIs e sejam capazes de executar processos de negócio com segurança, governança e geração de valor.


Se você tem experiência prática com Microsoft Copilot Studio e quer atuar na construção de soluções corporativas de IA em um ambiente global, essa oportunidade pode ser para você! pode ser para você!


Formação: Ensino Superior ou cursando em Tecnologia


Onde? 100% remoto


Benefícios e Incentivos: Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistências Médica e Odontológica (SulAmérica), Seguro de Vida (Prudential), Previdência Privada (Onze) e acesso ao WellHub para cuidar da mente e do corpo, além de VR Caju.


Desenvolvimento: Coparticipação na assinatura do Alura, ajuda para cursos de inglês, Ciclo de Avaliação de Desempenho com Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), e programas internos de mentoria e capacitação profissional.


Equilíbrio: Com nosso benefício de Antecipação de Férias, quem tem entre 6 e 12 meses de contrato pode aproveitar o descanso sem perder esse direito ao mudar de emprego.


Diversidade e Inclusão: Todas as nossas oportunidades são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência.


Sobre a Elumini Somos uma consultoria sólida no mercado de TI, com operações na América do Sul, América do Norte e Europa. Certificada pelo Great Place to Work®, somos reconhecidos por nossa forma única de valorizar profissionais e promover um ambiente diferenciado.


Candidate-se e decole sua carreira! Venha ser um(a) Eluminer!

title: CRM Coordinator
description:
Job Title: CRM Coordinator

Location: Remote – Brazil

Mode: Contract

Job Summary:

The CRM Coordinator supports the execution and operations of customer relationship management CRM initiatives with a primary focus on inapp banner workflows This role partners closely with crossfunctional teams and vendors to ensure timely execution accurate reporting and smooth daytoday CRM operations The ideal candidate is highly organized detailoriented and comfortable managing multiple tools and processes


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the endtoend inapp banner workflow including execution and reporting in partnership with the vendor Recurly Engage
  • Own the endtoend email push workflow including execution and reporting in partnership with the vendor Salesforce Marketing Cloud
  • Log track and help resolve issues across CRM platforms including Salesforce Mkt Cloud SDKs Redfast and related tools
  • Organize and maintain team assets including naming conventions calendars and shared folders
  • Assist in maintaining documentation playbooks and internal CRM processes to support team efficiency and consistency
  • Provide coverage for CRM assignments when the Manager or Senior Manager is out of office ensuring continuity of operations
  • Support daytoday CRM coordination and operational tasks as needed


Required Skills Qualifications:

  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously
  • Familiarity with CRM and marketing technology platforms eg Salesforce Braze or similar
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Comfort working with vendors and crossfunctional partners
  • Comfort writing copy for marketing communications


Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2 years of prior experience in CRM operations lifecycle marketing or marketing operations
  • Experience working with inapp messaging or banner tools eg Redfast or similar platforms
  • Basic reporting or analytics experience
  • Basic HTML experience
  • Language skills English nice to have italian german danish or swedish

title: Senior AI Agent Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research

coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.


The role

We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the

evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.

The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and

inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a

person reviews before anything happens with it.

Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,

traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.

You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've

shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea

whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.


What you'll do

• Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling,

included but not limited to the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK,

LangGraph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.

• Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems

are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation.

• Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect

entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch.

• Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to

Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses.

Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task.

• Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence

signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.

• Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.

Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both.

• Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as

regression tests.

• Compare models against each other (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt

strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.

• Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means

generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will

eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.

• Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to

you.


Required Qualifications:

• 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real

users touched.

• You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about

a multi-step run.

• You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and

turned them into something an agent can call reliably.

• You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against

a structured source of truth.

• You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.

• You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and

what to do about it.

• You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question

being asked instead of a nearby one.

• You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval

for them.

• You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.

• You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the

furthest east we can go.

You might currently be titled

AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI

Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI

Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll

go on what you've shipped.


Preferred Qualifications:

• You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking.

• You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, LangGraph, or the OpenAI

Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong.

• You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance.

• You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences.

• You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.


This is a fully remote, full-time permanent position available to candidates located within the New York (ET) through Western Europe time zones, with flexible working hours to support collaboration across regions.

evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.

The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and

inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a

person reviews before anything happens with it.

Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,

traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.

You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've

LangGraph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.

signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.

• Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.

• Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as

regression tests.

strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.

eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.

• Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to

you.

• You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval

for them.

• You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.

• You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the

furthest east we can go.

title: Analista de SDR Junior
description:
A FRST Falconi é uma spin-off da Falconi , uma das maiores consultorias de gestão empresarial do mundo! Criada há 5 anos para escalar o desenvolvimento de pessoas e transformar aprendizado em performance. Com base no PDCA e em IA Conversativa , criamos um ecossistema que acelera a resolução de problemas, fortalece a cultura organizacional e prepara lideranças.

Mais que uma universidade corporativa , somos o Ecossistema de Resultados Reais — onde o aprendizado vira ação e a ação, sucesso.

Agora, queremos alguém para crescer com a gente

Buscamos uma Pessoa SDR Júnior , com vontade de aprender, perfil comunicativo e interesse em desenvolver uma carreira na área comercial. Se você gosta de conversar com pessoas, é organizado(a) e quer crescer em um ambiente de tecnologia e inovação, essa oportunidade é para você.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Prospectar ativamente potenciais clientes B2B (Outbound);
  • Realizar o primeiro contato por e-mail, telefone, LinkedIn e WhatsApp;
  • Identificar oportunidades e entender as necessidades dos potenciais clientes;
  • Qualificar leads e agendar reuniões para o time de vendas;
  • Registrar e manter as informações atualizadas no CRM;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de Marketing e Vendas para gerar novas oportunidades de negócio.


O que buscamos:

  • Alguma experiência em atendimento ao cliente, vendas, prospecção ou áreas relacionadas (estágios também são bem-vindos);
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Organização, disciplina e vontade de aprender;
  • Perfil proativo, colaborativo e orientado a resultados;
  • Interesse por tecnologia e desenvolvimento profissional.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento ou interesse em prospecção outbound;
  • Familiaridade com CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce ou similares);
  • Conhecimento básico em metodologias de vendas, como SPIN Selling ou BANT;
  • Experiência em startups ou empresas de tecnologia.


O que oferecemos

  • Cultura colaborativa, com autonomia e aprendizado constante;
  • Desenvolvimento por meio de treinamentos e acompanhamento próximo da liderança;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, inovador e com alto potencial de crescimento;
  • Oportunidade real de crescimento na FRST.

﻿

Quer iniciar ou acelerar sua carreira em vendas, aprender com um time experiente e crescer em uma empresa de tecnologia? Vem construir com a gente!

title: Junior Spanish Recruiter
description:
Location: São Paulo, SP or Bragança Paulista, SP

Work Model: Hybrid or Remote


About the Role

We are looking for a Junior Recruiter to join our team and support our staffing and outsourcing operations .


This role is ideal for someone who is building a career in recruitment and enjoys connecting with people, identifying talent, and building candidate relationships . You will support recruitment processes for international clients and candidates, with a strong focus on the Spanish-speaking market .


What You'll Do

  • Source and build pipelines of qualified candidates.
  • Conduct initial candidate screenings and interviews.
  • Review resumes and assess candidates against job requirements.
  • Conduct outreach through calls, messages, and other sourcing channels.
  • Maintain accurate candidate information in our internal systems.
  • Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to support hiring needs.
  • Work toward weekly recruitment activity and productivity goals.


What We're Looking For

  • Fluent English and Spanish .
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to build relationships and confidently speak with candidates.
  • Good organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working with activity goals and recruitment targets.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • High motivation and interest in developing a career in recruitment.


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in recruitment, sourcing, HR, customer service, or sales .
  • Experience recruiting for the Spanish-speaking market .
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, or ATS platforms .
  • Experience in staffing, outsourcing, or international recruitment.


If you're energetic, people-oriented, and ready to grow your career in recruitment, we'd love to hear from you!
