title: Online Business English Teacher
description:
About the job

Company Description C-Leader English Academy helps professionals and executives develop the business English they need to perform in real-world corporate situations. The academy offers highly personalized programs tailored to each learner’s professional context, goals, and communication challenges, avoiding generic classes and focusing on efficiency. Its method combines realistic business scenarios, strategic communication practice, and direct application to daily work routines. This approach builds confidence, clarity, and measurable impact in the workplace. C-Leader is ideal for those seeking structured, purposeful, and fast-paced language development that supports leadership and global positioning.

Role Description

The Online Business English Teacher will deliver high-quality business-focused English lessons to professionals and executives, using C-Leader’s personalized methodology. Day-to-day tasks include preparing tailored lesson plans based on learners’ industries and roles, conducting live online classes, and focusing on communication skills for meetings, presentations, negotiations, and leadership contexts. The teacher will assess learner progress, provide detailed feedback, and adjust content to address evolving communication needs and business scenarios. Responsibilities also include maintaining accurate records of sessions, collaborating with the academic team to refine materials, and ensuring a consistent, professional learning experience. This is an online work position, and is open only to non-Brazilian candidates.


Requirements/Qualifications: (Please ONLY apply if you MEET ALL the following requisites)

-ACTIVE CNPJ is essential and mandatory

-FLUENT ENGLISH at teaching level with excellent grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation suitable for business environments.

-International TEACHING CERTIFICATION or graduation in Education, Languages, Linguistics, Business, or a related field; international teaching certificates (e.g., CELTA, TESOL).

-Proven solid EXPERIENCE teaching English to professionals or executives, with a focus on business or corporate communication.

-Proven experience with ONLINE TEACHING

-Ability to design and deliver personalized lesson plans based on learners’ job roles, industries, and real business situations.

-Skills in facilitating communication practice for meetings, presentations, negotiations, and leadership interactions.

-Comfort with online teaching tools, learning platforms, and digital resources to support interactive and engaging classes.

-Strong interpersonal skills, cultural awareness, and the ability to work with diverse, high-level professionals in a respectful, inclusive manner.

-Know how to use Google Meet and Notion for teaching

-Having a good computer setup and a stable internet connection

title: HR Business Partner - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role: We are looking for a HR Business Partner to join our Human Resources team. We are looking for proactive, dynamic people and team players, with great organizational capacity, accustomed to handle multiple tasks and with marked attention to details. It is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!


Key responsibilities:


- Hold regular meetings with the respective business units and management, providing guidance on HR issues.

- Analyze trends and metrics related to the level of rotation in order to develop solutions, programs and policies to increase retention.

- Stay updated on the legal requirements related to the daily management of employees, giving priority to the reduction of legal risks and guaranteeing regulatory compliance.

- Provide guidance and assistance in interpreting HR policies.

- Solve complex problems of various kinds related to employees.

- Assist international employees with expatriation assignments and HR-related matters.


Requirements:


- Previous experience in similar positions within the area.

- Knowledge of the labor regulations of Argentina and Latin America.

- Communication skills.

- Experience in the IT industry or regional responsibility (desirable).

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Electrical BIM/VDC Coordinator
description:
At Consultores de Empresas , we are looking for an Electrical BIM/VDC Coordinator !

We are seeking a professional with experience in BIM/VDC, electrical modeling, and construction project coordination to join a team working on highly complex commercial projects.


Key Responsibilities

  • Interpret and analyze construction documentation for electrical systems.
  • Design and model conduit systems according to design and constructability criteria.
  • Develop and manage LOD 400 electrical models in Revit .
  • Perform clash detection and resolution using Navisworks and Revizto .
  • Coordinate the electrical model with different disciplines and project teams.
  • Produce sleeve drawings, embedded points, and coordinate shop drawings.
  • Ensure model accuracy and compliance with applicable codes.
  • Resolve modeling issues and provide technical solutions.
  • Support field operations through remote coordination.
  • Occasionally collaborate on mechanical/MEP and process piping modeling tasks.


Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in BIM/VDC and construction modeling .
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in electrical project coordination .
  • Experience in electrical trades/installations.
  • Revit mandatory , with strong experience in detailed electrical modeling.
  • Experience working with LOD 350–400 electrical models .
  • Experience interpreting construction documentation.
  • Knowledge of Navisworks and/or Revizto .
  • Knowledge of AutoCAD and BIM 360 is a plus.
  • Understanding of MEP systems and their integration into modeling workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving and coordination skills.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in remote environments.


Project Experience

Experience in the following projects is a plus:

  • ️ Data Centers / Critical Infrastructure
  • Healthcare Facilities
  • Educational Institutions
  • Semiconductor Manufacturing Plants
  • Commercial and Retail Projects


We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Excellent communication and strong remote work capabilities.
  • A proactive and autonomous approach.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and a strong focus on quality.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Interest in adopting new tools and industry practices.


Location: Latin America | Remote

If you have experience in BIM/VDC and electrical modeling in Revit , we want to hear from you!

title: Administrador(a) de Dados Senior
description:
Buscamos um(a) Administrador(a) de Dados Sênior com experiência sólida em administração e modelagem de dados, conhecimento em negócios bancários e atuação com framework BIAN, arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA), Apache Kafka e governança de eventos .

O profissional atuará na modelagem, administração e governança de dados e eventos, trabalhando de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, analistas de negócio e equipes de desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades

  • Administrar e modelar dados nos níveis conceitual, lógico e físico , alinhados às necessidades de negócio e aos requisitos regulatórios;
  • Aplicar os princípios do framework BIAN na modelagem de dados, serviços bancários e integrações sistêmicas;
  • Atuar na governança de dados transacionais e orientados a eventos , definindo padrões, políticas e melhores práticas;
  • Definir, versionar e governar eventos em Apache Kafka , incluindo tópicos, contratos de dados e fluxos de publicação e consumo;
  • Projetar, estruturar e manter schemas AVRO , garantindo compatibilidade, versionamento e aderência aos padrões corporativos;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de qualidade de dados, catálogo de dados, linhagem e metadados corporativos ;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos de solução, arquitetos corporativos, analistas de negócio e times de desenvolvimento ;
  • Atuar junto às esteiras CI/CD , apoiando a automação de deploys e validações de modelos, eventos e schemas;
  • Documentar e manter atualizados os ativos de dados, eventos e artefatos de governança .

Requisitos

Experiência e conhecimentos técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em administração e modelagem de dados ;
  • Conhecimento de negócios bancários , principalmente em assuntos como Cheque Especial, Conta e Pagamentos ;
  • Conhecimento prático e aplicável do framework BIAN ;
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) e Apache Kafka ;
  • Conhecimento em governança de eventos , incluindo definição de contratos, versionamento e políticas de compatibilidade;
  • Experiência na modelagem e gestão de schemas AVRO (Schema Registry) ;
  • Conhecimento em esteiras CI/CD ;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de modelagem de dados como Erwin, PowerDesigner ou similares ;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL ;
  • Entendimento e aplicação de normas de compliance e privacidade de dados , incluindo LGPD e GDPR .

Formação

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas .

title: SDR Comercial
description:
Vaga: SDR Comercial — Secretaria IA


Modelo: PJ - Sem Fixo, Comissão Agressiva Acima do Mercado | 100% remoto

Área: Vendas / Pré-vendas


Sobre a Secretária IA

Na Secretária IA, estamos revolucionando o setor da saúde (clínicas médicas e odontológicas) através de tecnologia de ponta. Nossa missão é automatizar processos e otimizar a gestão, permitindo que os profissionais foquem no que realmente importa: o paciente. Estamos crescendo rápido e buscando mentes brilhantes que queiram construir o futuro da IA aplicada a negócios reais.


O desafio

Você será responsável por identificar, qualificar, e prospectar profissionais da saúde que podem se beneficiar da Secretária IA, criando oportunidades comerciais e ajudando a estruturar nosso processo de vendas.

Buscamos alguém que tenha fome de crescer, que se sinta confortável em trabalhar no modelo comissionado e que goste de prospecção e tenha interesse em participar não apenas da execução, mas também da construção do processo comercial e do CRM.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Prospectar médicos, dentistas, esteticistas, cirurgiões e outros profissionais da saúde;
  • Realizar prospecção ativa por WhatsApp, Instagram, Telefone e outros canais;
  • Qualificar e identificar potenciais clientes advindos do marketing e entender suas dores relacionadas a agenda e atendimento;
  • Fazer o primeiro contato e qualificar leads;
  • Agendar demonstrações/reuniões comerciais;
  • Realizar follow-ups;
  • Alimentar e manter o CRM atualizado;
  • Criar e acompanhar etapas do funil de vendas;
  • Sugerir melhorias no processo comercial;
  • Acompanhar métricas como leads prospectados, contatos realizados, reuniões agendadas, conversão e vendas.


O que buscamos

Essencial:

  • Experiência ou interesse em atuar como SDR/BDR;
  • Perfil comercial e comunicativo;
  • Organização e disciplina para trabalhar remotamente;
  • Conhecimento de CRM e funil de vendas;
  • Capacidade de construir e organizar processos dentro do CRM;
  • Conhecimento de prospecção ativa;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Orientação para metas e resultados.
  • Será um diferencial:
  • Experiência vendendo SaaS;
  • Experiência com HealthTech;
  • Conhecimento de vendas B2B/B2C;
  • Experiência com profissionais liberais;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas como HubSpot, Pipedrive, RD Station, Kommo ou similares;
  • Experiência na construção de automações e cadências comerciais;
  • Conhecimento de métricas de vendas.

title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Telecom Procurement Manager - Brazil(A222022)
description:
Responsibilities:

- Explore all relevant telecommunications resources (VOIP, SIP trunk, SMS channel) in target countries, industries, and target markets

- Maintain good relationships with telecom resource suppliers/ telecom operators

- Attend telecom trade meetings periodically

- Work closely with the team to integrate telecom resources into our product/platform


Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

- +5 Years of practical experience in exploring/purchasing telecom resources. (sip trunk, sms channel)

- Great passion for technology products and the telecom industry

- Good at critical reasoning and multi-tasking implementation

- Good communicative skills and business acumen

- Passionate and result-oriented

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office

- Proficiency in English.


Preferred Qualifications:

- Work experience in telecom operators.

- Five years or more of practical experience in telecom resource sales and purchasing

- Good understanding of industry research

- Successful track record in maintaining supplier relationships and people management

- Good interpersonal and teamwork skills.


About AI Rudder

AI Rudder is a conversational AI company on a mission to transform how businesses communicate with their customers — across voice and digital channels that feel genuinely human.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Singapore, we're building technologies that bridge languages, enhance understanding, and enable meaningful human–machine communication at scale.

Today, we serve 500+ enterprise clients globally processing 50 million calls daily and having delivered more than 8 billion calls to date.

Most recently, we have raised $50M in a Series B fundraising from leading global investors including Tiger Global, Peak XV Partners, and Cathay Innovation.


How We Work

AI-first: AI isn't a tool we reach for. It's the default we start from. Every team, every workflow: AI-first.

Global Collaboration: We operate globally and work as one team. Distance is a logistics problem, not a cultural one. We build the habits that make distributed teams actually work.

Communication Principle: Simple, Trust, Transparent. We remove unnecessary complexity so people can focus on what matters most.


What We Offer

Learning & Development: Continuous learning through real projects, knowledge sharing session, mentorship, and cross-functional collaboration.

Performance Recognition: Regular performance reviews, feedback, and opportunities for career progression.

Global Exposure: Collaborate with international teams, global rotations, and work with global enterprise customers.

Meaningful Impact: Build AI solutions that create real value for businesses around the world.

Ownership & Autonomy: Freedom to take initiative and drive outcomes.

Team Engagement: Team Building, Local & Global Gatherings & Local Events Celebration.


AI Rudder is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants.

title: Finance Analyst - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are seeking a Finance Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Finance Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Perform research and gather documentation to compile comprehensive reports delivering operational reports, and transactional tasks.

- Work with banking/financial entities, international agencies, or government officials.

- Assist in vendor and client registration, purchasing, and accounts payable processes.

- Data processing: responsible for updating records in the company system.

- Assist in the department's programs, projects, and processes.

- Assist in the preparation of monthly financial reports.

- Assist in tracking due dates and compliance with US tax returns and other legal requirements.


Requirements:


- 3+ years of experience working in finance areas.

- Expertise with web-based tools.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Interpersonal and presentation skills.

- Organized and detail-oriented.

- Proven organizational skills.

- Advanced English, both spoken and written (a must).


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

title: Accounting Analyst - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Process Data & Integration Specialist position involves streamlining workflows and enhancing operational efficiency. This role requires designing and implementing automated solutions, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and optimizing data processes. You'll work at the intersection of data, automation, and integration, building systems that eliminate manual work and empower teams to focus on high-value activities.


Key responsibilities


- Developing and maintaining scripts in Python for process automation.

- Creating, optimizing, and maintaining queries in SQL for data manipulation and analysis.

- Building integrations between systems using automation tools such as Workato, Zapier, or n8n.

- Automating workflows between APIs, databases, and internal tools.

- Organizing and analyzing data using spreadsheets such as Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel.

- Documenting integrations, automations, and implemented processes.

- Collaborating with product, data, and operations teams to improve operational efficiency.


Requirements


- Integration and Automation: Experience with data integration and process automation.

- Python Proficiency: Proficiency in Python for automation or data processing.

- Automation Platforms: Experience with at least one automation/integration platform such as Workato, Zapier, or n8n.

- SQL Skills: Strong SQL skills for querying and manipulating databases.

- Spreadsheet Expertise: Experience working with spreadsheets including Excel or Google Sheets for data manipulation.

- API Knowledge: Basic knowledge of REST APIs.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.

Additional skills preferred

- ETL Processes: Experience with ETL processes or data pipelines.

- API Integration: Knowledge of webhooks and API integrations.

- Version Control: Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.

- Process Automation: Background in business process automation (BPA/RPA).

- AI Tools: Experience with AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, Claude, and Gemini.

title: Enterprise Account Executive – Strategic Partnerships
description:
Remote – Brazil | Full-Time | U.S. Market


Base Salary: $3,000–$3,500 USD/month + Uncapped Commission


Target OTE: $80,000–$100,000+ USD


We're Looking for A hunter.


This is not an Account Executive role where qualified meetings magically appear on your calendar.


There is no SDR handing you opportunities.


There is no list of warm leads waiting for you.


You will identify the accounts you want to win, find the decision-makers, get their attention, book the meeting, run the sales process, negotiate the deal, and close the business.


If building your own pipeline sounds exhausting, this probably isn't the role for you.


If you’ve built a career by creating opportunities other salespeople couldn't find and closing deals other salespeople couldn't close, keep reading.


What You'll Be Selling


Revenx helps financial professionals connect with public employees who are approaching important retirement decisions.


We're expanding our enterprise business and looking to build partnerships with IMOs, FMOs, large insurance agencies, financial services organizations, and other enterprise partners that can deploy our appointment programs across their organizations.


We're not looking for someone to sell individual agents.


We're looking for someone who can get in front of executives and decision-makers and close meaningful enterprise relationships.


You Own the Entire Sales Cycle


You will be responsible for:

  • Identifying and researching target enterprise accounts
  • Building your own prospect lists and pipeline
  • Cold calling executives and decision-makers
  • Cold emailing
  • Prospecting and connecting through LinkedIn
  • Creating multi-touch outbound strategies to break into difficult accounts
  • Setting your own appointments
  • Running discovery calls
  • Identifying organizational needs and buying opportunities
  • Presenting our enterprise solutions
  • Building proposals
  • Navigating multiple stakeholders
  • Handling objections
  • Negotiating agreements
  • Closing new enterprise business
  • Handing signed accounts to Customer Success
  • Going back out and finding the next one

Prospect. Book. Discover. Present. Negotiate. Close. Repeat.


What We're Looking For


We care far more about what you've actually done than what your previous title was.

You should have:

  • Proven success in B2B sales
  • Experience personally generating outbound pipeline
  • Experience selling to executives, owners, or senior decision-makers
  • Strong cold calling ability
  • Strong written outbound prospecting skills
  • Excellent spoken and written English
  • Experience running discovery and closing your own opportunities
  • Confidence negotiating larger contracts
  • A history of consistently hitting or exceeding sales targets
  • Strong CRM discipline
  • The ability to operate independently without needing someone to tell you who to call next

Experience selling into financial services, insurance, SaaS, marketing services, lead generation, or other complex B2B environments is a plus.


This Role is NOT For You If....


Your last company gave you most of your appointments.

You rely heavily on SDRs to build pipeline.

You consider sending a few LinkedIn messages \"prospecting.\"

You are uncomfortable making cold calls.

You need a recognizable brand name to get meetings.

You are great at relationship management but don't love closing.

You want to inherit an existing book of business.

You are looking for an account management role.

This is a new-business hunter role.

What Success Looks Like


We are not hiring you to stay busy.

We're hiring you to generate new enterprise revenue.

You'll be measured primarily on:

  • Qualified enterprise pipeline created
  • New enterprise opportunities generated
  • New enterprise revenue closed
  • New enterprise accounts acquired
  • Quota attainment

Activity matters because activity creates pipeline.

But ultimately, you are here to close business.

Compensation


Base Salary: $3,000–$3,500 USD per month, depending on experience

On-Target Earnings: $80,000–$100,000+ USD annually

Commission: Uncapped

Exceptional performance should result in exceptional compensation. We do not want a commission structure that makes our best salesperson slow down after hitting quota.

The Person We're Looking For


You're resourceful.

You don't wait for leads.

You know how to get someone's attention when they've never heard of you.

You can speak comfortably with a salesperson one minute and an agency owner or executive the next.

You aren't intimidated by a difficult prospect.

You follow up relentlessly without becoming annoying.

You understand that \"not interested\" isn't always the end of a sales process.

Most importantly, you close.

If your strongest sales results came from opportunities you personally created, we'd like to talk to you.

How to Apply:

Send your resume to and tell us:

What was the largest B2B deal you personally sourced and closed?

Include:

  • How you originally found the account
  • How you got the first meeting
  • Approximate contract value
  • Length of the sales cycle
  • Your role in closing the deal


If most of your historical pipeline was generated by SDRs or inbound marketing, please be transparent about that.


We're specifically looking for someone who has proven they can create pipeline and close it.

title: Squad Leader
description:
Somos a Framework! Evoluímos grandes marcas em todo o mundo com transformação digital e crescemos continuamente através de agilidade, design e tecnologia.

Fazer parte do nosso time é saber que a sua jornada será de desafios reais, de crescimento contínuo e de contato diário com referências em tecnologia. Vem com a gente!

*Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para PCDs!


Benefícios? É claro que temos!

Vale alimentação e refeição no cartão Sólides Benefícios com mais de R$ 1.200,00 mensais

Auxílio home office no valor de R$ 150,00 mensais

🚗 Você decide entre vale-transporte ou vale-combustível, no caso de vagas híbridas e presenciais

Plano de saúde e auxílio odontológico de alta qualidade

❤️ Seguro de vida que cobre doenças ocupacionais

Participação nos lucros

Total Pass para se manter saudável

Trib Pass para trocar moedas digitais por hospedagens e passagens aéreas com cobertura mundial

Licença maternidade estendida: 180 dias

Licença paternidade estendida: 30 dias

🥦 Desconto em consultas nutricionais

🧠 Desconto em terapia online

🛍️ Clube de benefícios para quem gosta de comprar com descontos

Knowledge transfer através do Frame KT

Bonificação por indicação de novos colaboradores


E não paramos por aí!

Horário flexível

No dress code

Nas pausas presenciais, fique à vontade para comer pães, bolos e frutas

Ambiente leve, flexível e cultura colaborativa.

E qual será a sua missão na Framework?

  • Liderar a entrega do squad, garantindo previsibilidade, qualidade e alinhamento entre o time técnico e as expectativas. É responsável pela pela gestão de escopo e prazo.

O que é preciso para fazer parte do time?

  • Experiência em gestão/liderança de squads de tecnologia;
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban) e dos rituais de acompanhamento (planning, review,
  • status report);
  • Vivência gerenciando entregas técnicas com múltiplas integrações e stakeholders;
  • Capacidade de leitura técnica, entender riscos técnicos,débito técnico e arquitetura reportados pelo time.

A NOSSA EVOLUÇÃO É CRESCENTE!

E, para acompanhar esse crescimento, precisamos de pessoas que agreguem propondo ideias, soluções e desafios!

Gostou da oportunidade? Vamos juntos e faça parte da nossa história! #vempraframe

title: Senior Project Manager - IT Operations
description:
Mastery Consulting , with over 30 years of experience delivering specialized IT consulting and technology solutions, is seeking an experienced Senior IT Project Manager to join a strategic engagement with one of our U.S.-based clients.

In this role, you will lead a large-scale IT Operations integration initiative across two global organizations, coordinating cross-functional teams spanning Service Desk, Telephony, ServiceNow, Infrastructure, Network, and Security. You will play a key role in delivering a unified IT support model, driving operational excellence, and ensuring successful execution across multiple regions.

Overview

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Project Manager to lead the consolidation of IT Operations teams, including first- and second-level support, into a unified and modern IT support organization across two global companies. This transformation will be powered by ServiceNow and supported by a global follow-the-sun operating model.

You will own the end-to-end, multi-workstream project plan, simplifying how employees receive IT support, streamlining telephony and IVR services, and improving service quality and operational efficiency at scale. You will work closely with Infrastructure, End User Computing, Network, Telecom, Security, and ServiceNow teams to coordinate platform enhancements, process harmonization, and data and knowledge migration activities.

This role offers high executive visibility, involves managing complex dependencies, and provides the opportunity to make a significant impact on the overall employee support experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end project management for large-scale IT initiatives.
  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success criteria in collaboration with business stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, and resource allocations.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, including technical teams, business units, and third-party vendors.
  • Identify project risks and dependencies, implementing effective mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure compliance with IT governance, security policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Communicate project status, risks, and key milestones to executives and stakeholders.
  • Maintain resource plans and proactively address resource constraints.
  • Manage project financials, including budgeting, forecasting, and month-end reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 8–10+ years of experience leading large-scale IT infrastructure, operations, or integration projects across multiple regions.
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering enterprise-level IT initiatives involving multiple workstreams and vendors.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid project management methodologies.
  • Experience with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, and ServiceNow.
  • Strong financial management skills, including budgeting, forecasting, business case development, and risk management.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Advanced or fluent English, with the ability to lead meetings and communicate effectively with global stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL v4, or equivalent Project Management certification.
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow ITSM (Incident, Request, Problem, Change, Knowledge, and CMDB).
  • Previous experience leading IT Service Desk or IT Operations consolidation initiatives.
  • Experience coordinating global teams in a matrix organization.

Work Environment

This is a fully remote position. The primary working schedule follows the U.S. Central Time zone. Due to the global nature of this role, occasional meetings outside regular business hours may be required to collaborate effectively with international stakeholders across multiple time zones.


Application Instructions

Please send your CV in English only , including your expected monthly compensation (PJ)

title: Native or Bilingual German & Japanese Teachers | Freelance
description:
LingoGalaxy is looking for native or bilingual German- or Japanese-speaking teachers to deliver personalized online lessons to children and teenagers.


You do not need to be registered as a freelancer to work with LingoGalaxy.

All lessons are fully online, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere. Previous experience teaching children is preferred but not required .


What We Offer
  • Fully remote teaching — work from anywhere.
  • Flexible scheduling — minimum availability of 12 hours per week during our peak teaching hours:
  • 16:00–20:00 CET for European students
  • 16:00–20:00 EST for US students
  • Dedicated HR support — our HR team is available throughout your collaboration to assist with student-related, scheduling, technical, or other work-related issues.


Creative Freedom in Your Teaching

We encourage teachers to use their own teaching resources and create engaging, age-appropriate lesson presentations tailored to each student's needs.

This is an opportunity to use your own teaching style, creativity, and ideas to develop lessons that work well for your students and that you genuinely enjoy teaching. We also provide guidance and resources when needed.


Compensation
  • €8 per 30-minute lesson
  • €14 per 60-minute lesson


Requirements
  • Native or bilingual German or Japanese proficiency.
  • Availability for at least 12 hours per week during the specified peak hours .
  • Ability and willingness to create engaging, age-appropriate lesson materials.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable setup for online teaching.


If you are looking for a flexible online German or Japanese teaching opportunity where you can use your own teaching style and creativity, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Business Intelligence Partner - Remote Work
description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.


Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.


When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.


Talent Acquisition Senior Auditor at BairesDev


As a Senior Auditor , you'll play a key role in ensuring the quality, consistency, and reliability of recruitment audits. You'll handle complex and high-impact cases, review and guide junior auditors, and help align evaluation criteria across the team. This role offers the chance to make a real impact by improving the quality of hiring processes, working on meaningful and complex cases, shaping audit standards, and helping both processes and people grow through clear feedback and continuous improvement.


What You'll Do:


- Execute complex, sensitive, and high-impact audits.

- Supervise and review Junior Auditors' evaluations.

- Lead calibration calls and standardize criteria across the audit team.


What we are looking for:


- 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance roles.

- Proven experience auditing complex and high-impact roles, including senior profiles, closers, and specialized positions.

- Hands-on experience supervising and calibrating Junior Auditors to ensure consistency and accuracy across evaluations.

- Advanced proficiency in English.


Nice to have:


- Experience in Talent Acquisition.

- Experience working with high-volume recruitment processes.

- Experience in data analysis and SQL.


How we do make your work (and your life) easier:


- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and national holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.


Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

title: Data Scientist
description:
Senior Data Scientist – Forecasting & Optimization

Location: Brazil

Work model: Remote within Brazil

Employment type: Contract/PJ

Start date: As soon as possible


About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on, business-oriented Senior Data Scientist with strong experience in forecasting, predictive modeling, and optimization .


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys using data to solve practical business problems and can move comfortably between predictive modeling, exploratory data analysis, SQL queries, Excel-based analyses, and urgent stakeholder requests.


The successful candidate will focus on delivering measurable business value through pragmatic analytical solutions. This is not a research-oriented or GenAI-focused position. We are looking for someone who understands that the best solution is often the simplest approach that reliably answers the business need.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement forecasting and predictive models to support business planning and decision-making.
  • Build demand forecasting and time-series solutions using Python and SQL.
  • Develop optimization and product allocation models.
  • Analyze supply chain, inventory, allocation, and demand-planning challenges.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Respond to ad hoc analytical requests and urgent business questions.
  • Extract, manipulate, and analyze data using SQL, Python, and Excel.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand their needs and define practical analytical solutions.
  • Communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Balance longer-term analytical initiatives with immediate business priorities.
  • Select the most effective tool or methodology for each problem, from spreadsheets and SQL queries to predictive and optimization models.


Required Qualifications

  • Proven professional experience as a Data Scientist or in a similar analytical role.
  • Strong experience with forecasting, predictive analytics, and time-series modeling.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Advanced analytical skills using Excel.
  • Experience developing optimization models or solving decision-science and operations-research problems.
  • Strong exploratory data analysis and data interpretation skills.
  • Ability to translate business questions into analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and prioritize competing requests.
  • Must be based in Brazil and available to work remotely.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting supply chain, inventory, product allocation, retail, or demand-planning teams.
  • Experience building analytical solutions used in real business operations.
  • Familiarity with production-level forecasting or optimization solutions.
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments with changing priorities.


What Success Looks Like

You will succeed in this role if you can quickly understand business needs, work with available data, and deliver useful answers and solutions. You should be equally comfortable developing a forecasting model, investigating an unexpected business trend, writing SQL queries, creating an Excel analysis, or presenting recommendations to stakeholders.


We value practical problem-solving, flexibility, ownership, and business impact over unnecessary technical complexity.


Why Join Us?

  • Work remotely from anywhere in Brazil.
  • Contribute to high-impact forecasting, optimization, and business analytics initiatives.
  • Collaborate directly with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Apply advanced analytical skills to practical, real-world decisions.
  • Join a team that values adaptability, autonomy, and measurable results.

title: Head of Risk
description:
Head of Credit Risk

We’re partnering with a fast-growing, profitable fintech transforming how small businesses in Brazil access credit and working capital. The company has built a highly automated, data-driven credit platform and is entering its next phase of significant scale and product expansion.


The role:

  • Own credit strategy, policy, portfolio performance, and credit P&L
  • Identify opportunities to sustainably scale the existing credit business
  • Partner closely with Product to design and launch new credit products
  • Serve as a strategic counterpart to Data Science/modeling leadership
  • Set direction in a highly entrepreneurial, fast-moving environment
  • Build and develop a high-performing risk organization as the business scales


Ideal background:

  • Launched a new credit product and successfully scaled it
  • Managed a large-scale credit portfolio with meaningful P&L and policy ownership
  • Experience managing multiple credit products simultaneously
  • Strong technical fluency across underwriting, modeling, and data science
  • First-principles thinker who can challenge conventional credit assumptions
  • Proven ability to operate in high-growth environments with strategic ambiguity
  • Strong track record of attracting and developing top talent
  • Brazil / Portuguese fluency strongly preferred
company: CTB1LLC, a boutique talent and placement company

title: SDR / Pré-vendas (PJ · Home Office)
description:
A Vivaz é uma operação de marketing e growth que assume a pré-vendas de empresas B2B. Estamos montando o time de prospecção para atender contas de tecnologia e audiovisual, e procuramos um(a) SDR para ser a primeira pessoa a falar com o cliente: prospectar, qualificar e entregar oportunidades prontas para o time comercial fechar.

Você não precisa ter experiência longa em vendas. Precisa ser organizado(a), escrever bem, ter constância e não ter medo de puxar conversa com desconhecido no LinkedIn, e-mail e WhatsApp. O resto a gente treina.

O que você vai fazer

  • Prospecção ativa (LinkedIn, e-mail, WhatsApp) em listas de contas definidas — abordagem conta a conta (ABM), precisão em vez de volume.
  • Executar cadências de contato e manter o ritmo diário de toques.
  • Qualificar leads e agendar reuniões para o time comercial.
  • Manter o pipeline organizado e atualizado no CRM.
  • Registrar contexto de cada oportunidade para a passagem de bastão.

O que buscamos

  • Boa comunicação escrita (o teste começa já na sua candidatura).
  • Organização e disciplina para trabalhar sozinho(a), remoto, sem alguém cobrando de hora em hora.
  • Consistência: prospecção é ritmo diário, não pico.
  • Vontade de aprender vendas B2B e crescer na área.
  • Diferenciais (não obrigatórios): experiência com CRM, prospecção, atendimento, SDR ou vendas.

Formato e remuneração

  • Contrato PJ , 100% home office .
  • R$ 3.000 fixo mensal + variável por metas (oportunidades qualificadas / reuniões marcadas).
  • Rotina com acompanhamento próximo, treinamento e metas claras.

title: Sr Data Scientist Lead
description:
About Us

Coderio designs and delivers scalable digital solutions for global companies. We combine strong technical expertise with a product mindset to lead complex software initiatives end-to-end. We work with international clients, value autonomy and clear communication, and build long-term partnerships through technical excellence.

More information:


This position is only available for UY / ARG / BR


We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist Lead to join one of our international clients and lead the design, development, and delivery of data science solutions that generate measurable business value.

This is a high-impact technical leadership role for an experienced Data Scientist who combines strong hands-on expertise with the ability to guide technical decisions, mentor other data professionals, and collaborate with business and engineering stakeholders.

You will work across the full data science lifecycle, from understanding business problems and defining analytical approaches to developing machine learning models, deploying solutions to production, and continuously improving their performance.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, hands-on, business-oriented, and comfortable working with cloud-based data and machine learning environments, particularly AWS .


What To Expect In This Role (Responsibilities)

  • Data Science Leadership: Lead the design and implementation of data science initiatives, defining methodologies, technical approaches, and best practices across projects.
  • Machine Learning & Modeling: Develop, evaluate, and optimize statistical and machine learning models to solve complex business problems and generate actionable insights.
  • End-to-End Data Science: Own the complete data science lifecycle, including data exploration, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • AWS & Cloud Solutions: Design and implement scalable data science and machine learning solutions leveraging AWS cloud services and best practices.
  • Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance to Data Scientists and other technical team members, promoting high-quality engineering and analytical practices.
  • Business Collaboration: Work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, data engineers, and software engineers to translate business challenges into effective data-driven solutions.
  • Model Performance & Optimization: Monitor model performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure solutions remain accurate, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.
  • Data Strategy: Contribute to the definition of data science strategies, analytical frameworks, and best practices that support long-term business growth.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Mentor team members, conduct technical reviews, and promote knowledge sharing across the organization.


Requirements

  • Experience: 6+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, or a related field, with proven experience leading technical initiatives or teams.
  • Data Science Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with statistical modeling, machine learning algorithms, predictive analytics, experimentation, and data-driven problem solving.
  • Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python , with experience using common data science and machine learning libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, or similar.
  • Machine Learning: Strong understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering, optimization, and production machine learning practices.
  • AWS: Solid hands-on experience designing or implementing data science and machine learning solutions in AWS environments.
  • Data & SQL: Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets, data warehouses, and complex data environments.
  • Technical Leadership: Proven ability to lead technical discussions, make architecture and modeling decisions, mentor other professionals, and drive projects from concept to production.
  • Communication: Advanced English proficiency, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly with international teams, stakeholders, and leadership.
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with a pragmatic approach to solving complex business and technical challenges.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS services such as SageMaker, S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda, EMR, or Athena .
  • Experience deploying and monitoring machine learning models in production.
  • Experience with MLOps and ML lifecycle automation.
  • Experience with Spark or other distributed data processing frameworks.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, or NLP solutions.
  • AWS certifications related to Data, Machine Learning, or Solutions Architecture.
  • Experience working in financial services or other data-intensive industries.


Benefits

  • 100% remote work from UY / AR / BR
  • Long-term engagement with international clients.
  • High-impact technical leadership role.
  • Opportunity to influence data science and machine learning strategy.
  • Collaborative international environment with experienced technical teams.
  • Continuous learning and professional growth opportunities.


Why Join Coderio?

At Coderio, we value talent regardless of location. We are a fully remote company, passionate about technology, collaboration, and technical excellence. We offer an inclusive and challenging environment where experienced professionals can take ownership, influence technical strategy, and work on meaningful projects with global clients.

If you are an experienced Data Scientist who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with leadership, mentoring, and business impact, we'd love to hear from you.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Coderio designs and delivers scalable digital solutions for global companies. We combine strong technical expertise with a product mindset to lead complex software initiatives end-to-end. You will work across the full data science lifecycle, from understanding business problems and defining analytical approaches to developing machine learning models, deploying solutions to production, and continuously improving their performance.

  • End-to-End Data Science: Own the complete data science lifecycle, including data exploration, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • AWS: Solid hands-on experience designing or implementing data science and machine learning solutions in AWS environments.
  • Data & SQL: Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets, data warehouses, and complex data environments.
  • Technical Leadership: Proven ability to lead technical discussions, make architecture and modeling decisions, mentor other professionals, and drive projects from concept to production.
  • Communication: Advanced English proficiency, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly with international teams, stakeholders, and leadership.
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with a pragmatic approach to solving complex business and technical challenges.


Nice to Have

description:
The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced SAP Regional Consultant to join our team, with a broad profile covering Order-to-Cash (O2C) , Procure-to-Pay (P2P) , Record-to-Report (R2R) , and Plan-to-Deliver - Extended Warehouse Management (P2D-EWM) processes.

title: Gerente de Global Mobility (Expatriados) Global Employer Services - Belo Horizonte
description:
Você na Deloitte:

A Deloitte busca profissional para atuar como Gerente em Global Employer Services (GES) , com foco na gestão de projetos relacionados à mobilidade internacional e tributação de pessoas físicas (expatriados). Esta posição exige forte capacidade de gestão, relacionamento com clientes e visão estratégica para desenvolvimento de negócios.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar projetos de mobilidade internacional e tributação de expatriados, garantindo o cumprimento do cronograma físico-financeiro, qualidade das entregas e rentabilidade.
  • Atuar na gestão administrativa dos projetos, incluindo abertura de engagements, controle de faturamento de honorários e encerramento conforme políticas internas.
  • Conduzir projetos junto aos clientes, liderando reuniões, apresentações e solucionando desafios relacionados a prazos, qualidade e alocação de recursos.
  • Interagir com stakeholders de diferentes áreas das empresas clientes, assegurando alinhamento e execução eficiente dos projetos.
  • Direcionar e validar entregáveis, garantindo aderência às metodologias, planos de trabalho, templates e reports acordados.
  • Identificar oportunidades comerciais, compreendendo demandas dos clientes, elaborando propostas técnicas e precificação de projetos.
  • Apoiar os sócios na expansão de negócios, manutenção de relacionamento com clientes e desenvolvimento de novas oportunidades.
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e mentoria de profissionais da equipe, promovendo boas práticas e crescimento técnico.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação e/ou MBA em Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência consolidada em tributação de pessoas físicas , preferencialmente com foco em expatriados (Global Mobility / GES) .
  • Inglês fluente (indispensável).
  • Sólidos conhecimentos no Pacote Office.
  • Habilidade de gestão de projetos, relacionamento com clientes e desenvolvimento de negócios.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em consultorias Big Four.
  • Vivência com estruturas internacionais e planejamento tributário global para indivíduos.
  • Conhecimento em políticas de mobilidade internacional e compliance para expatriados.

title: Bolsista Doutor em Engenharia - EIT Caldeiraria - Implantação de PCP | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A EIT Caldeiraria Ltda atua na fabricação e execução de soluções em caldeiraria industrial, atendendo demandas de produção e montagem com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e atendimento às necessidades operacionais dos clientes. Com forte interface entre engenharia e chão de fábrica, a empresa busca evoluir sua gestão produtiva para ganhar previsibilidade, produtividade e competitividade.

Neste projeto, a atuação será voltada à implantação de Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP) para otimizar o fluxo de trabalho na caldeiraria, aumentando a eficiência operacional e reduzindo custos e prazos de entrega. A iniciativa envolve estruturar rotinas, métodos e ferramentas de planejamento, sequenciamento e acompanhamento da produção, consolidando uma base de gestão que permita melhor tomada de decisão e maior controle sobre capacidade, materiais e prazos.

Se você tem perfil analítico e interesse em atuar diretamente na melhoria de processos e gestão da produção industrial, contribuindo para resultados mensuráveis em produtividade e entrega, venha fazer parte desse desafio.

Projeto: Implantação de Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP) para aumento de eficiência, redução de custos e prazos de entrega na caldeiraria industrial.

Formação Acadêmica: Doutorado em Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Industrial, Engenharia de Manufatura.

Principais Atividades:

• Diagnóstico e mapeamento do processo produtivo;

• Estruturação de dados e parâmetros de planejamento;

• Implantação das rotinas de PCP;

• Integração com compras e gestão de materiais;

• Monitoramento de indicadores e melhoria contínua;

• Padronização, documentação e treinamento;

Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos:

• PCP aplicado: noções sólidas de planejamento, sequenciamento, capacidade, lead time e estoques;

• Mapeamento/diagnóstico de processo produtivo e definição de rotinas de PCP;

• Estruturação e parametrização de dados básicos;

• Excel intermediário/avançado para análises e indicadores;

• Gestão por indicadores e melhoria contínua;

Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais:

• Experiência prática implantando PCP (ou reestruturação completa)

• Vivência com ERP e módulos de produção/materiais (SAP, TOTVS etc.) e/ou APS/MES

• Ferramentas Lean e qualidade (VSM, Kaizen, 5S, DMAIC, CEP)

• Integração forte com compras/suprimentos e gestão de materiais (ABC, políticas de estoque, inventário)

• Experiência com treinamento e gestão da mudança (padronização, capacitação de equipe)

Valor da bolsa (mensal): Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Presencial / Paiçandu PR. Soft Skills: Autogestão, Trabalho em equipe, Autonomia, Criatividade, Ética e Responsabilidade, organização.

title: Gerente de Contas Sudeste
description:
About the role

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Contas Foodservice para impulsionar o crescimento dos negócios da Kerry na Região Sudeste do Brasil por meio da gestão estratégica de distribuidores de foodservice e operadores de vending machine. Esta posição terá papel fundamental na aceleração do sell-out, expansão da base de clientes e desenvolvimento de planos de negócio sustentáveis, atuando de forma próxima aos parceiros comerciais e equipes de vendas em campo.

Além da responsabilidade comercial, o profissional liderará diretamente um colaborador, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento da equipe, execução da estratégia comercial e alcance dos objetivos de crescimento da região.

Key responsibilities

  • Sell-out
  • Cobertura geográfica

  • Mix e desenvolvimento de categorias
  • Desenvolver iniciativas comerciais e programas de incentivo para acelerar resultados e aumentar a produtividade dos distribuidores.
  • Realizar visitas constantes a campo, acompanhando rotas e apoiando diretamente as equipes comerciais dos distribuidores.
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão da carteira de clientes e crescimento da participação de mercado no Sudeste.
  • Prospectar novos distribuidores e desenvolver novos negócios para as marcas de Foodservice da Kerry.
  • Treinar e capacitar equipes de vendas dos distribuidores sobre produtos, portfólio e oportunidades de mercado.
  • Trabalhar de forma consultiva com clientes e distribuidores para desenvolver soluções alinhadas às necessidades dos segmentos de foodservice.
  • Gerenciar e expandir projetos junto a operadores estratégicos de vending machine, garantindo crescimento sustentável, rentabilidade e aumento da participação de mercado.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com contas-chave do segmento de vending machine e identificar oportunidades de inovação e expansão do canal.
  • Colaborar com as áreas de Supply Chain, Customer Care, Marketing e demais áreas internas para assegurar excelência na execução comercial e assertividade de forecast.
  • Participar de eventos, Innovation Days e iniciativas estratégicas voltadas ao desenvolvimento do canal Foodservice.

Qualifications and skills

  • Mínimo de 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área comercial, preferencialmente nos segmentos de Foodservice, Ingredientes, Café, Panificação, Confeitaria ou canais indiretos.
  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial, Engenharia de Alimentos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência na gestão e desenvolvimento de distribuidores de foodservice.
  • Experiência comprovada no canal de vending machine é mandatória (must-have).
  • Histórico consistente de resultados em gestão de contas estratégicas e desenvolvimento de negócios no segmento de vending machine.
  • Experiência prévia em liderança de pessoas, desenvolvimento de equipes e gestão de performance.
  • Experiência comprovada na construção e execução de Joint Business Plans (JBP).
  • Vivência na gestão de indicadores comerciais e desenvolvimento de estratégias de crescimento.
  • Forte atuação em campo e experiência acompanhando equipes comerciais e distribuidores.
  • Conhecimento avançado de gestão de canais indiretos e distribuidores.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver estratégias de sell-out e expansão de mercado.
  • Conhecimento de indicadores de distribuição e performance comercial.
  • Experiência na criação e implementação de programas de incentivo e ativação comercial.
  • Capacidade analítica para acompanhamento de KPIs e identificação de oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Habilidade para conduzir negociações comerciais complexas e projetos estratégicos.
  • Forte capacidade de liderança, influência e desenvolvimento de times.
  • Perfil altamente energético e orientado para resultados.
  • Forte senso de dono e espírito empreendedor.
  • Visão estratégica combinada com excelência na execução.
  • Perfil proativo, resiliente e focado em crescimento.
  • Facilidade para construir relacionamentos e influenciar parceiros comerciais.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes e forte presença em campo.
  • Flexibilidade para atuar em diferentes segmentos dentro do canal foodservice.

About Kerry

A Kerry é a empresa líder mundial em soluções de sabor e nutrição para as indústrias de alimentos, bebidas e farmacêutica. Todos os dias, trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para criar produtos mais saudáveis, saborosos e sustentáveis, consumidos por bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Nossa visão é ser o parceiro mais valorizado de nossos clientes, contribuindo para um mundo de nutrição sustentável. Construir uma carreira na Kerry significa ter a oportunidade de ajudar a moldar o futuro da alimentação, ao mesmo tempo em que desenvolve seu potencial em um ambiente verdadeiramente global e diverso.

title: Partner Management Manager (Commercial Focus)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Partner Management Manager to lead strategic partnerships and drive sustainable business growth. This role requires a strong commercial mindset, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and proven experience navigating complex and long sales cycles with senior decision-makers.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, negotiating, and managing high-impact partnerships while owning the full partnership lifecycle—from opportunity identification and deal structuring through implementation, growth, and long-term relationship management.

This is a highly cross-functional role that requires close collaboration with Operations, Product, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and senior leadership teams.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Partnership Development

  • Identify, evaluate, and develop strategic partnership opportunities aligned with company growth objectives.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key external stakeholders, including C-level executives and senior decision-makers.
  • Develop partnership strategies that create long-term commercial value and competitive advantage.
  • Conduct market analysis to identify emerging trends, white spaces, and new business opportunities.

Commercial Negotiation & Deal Management

  • Lead complex commercial negotiations involving multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and sophisticated deal structures.
  • Own the end-to-end partnership process, from prospecting and opportunity qualification to contract execution and post-launch growth.
  • Structure and negotiate commercial agreements, pricing models, revenue-sharing frameworks, and strategic collaboration terms.
  • Manage contract renewals, renegotiations, and expansion opportunities to maximize partner lifetime value.
  • Drive alignment among internal and external stakeholders throughout the negotiation process.

Partner Growth & Account Management

  • Develop strategic account plans for key partners to drive revenue growth and deepen relationships.
  • Monitor partnership performance through KPIs, business reviews, and growth initiatives.
  • Identify upselling, cross-selling, and expansion opportunities within existing partnerships.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with partners to ensure alignment, performance, and long-term success.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience in Business Development, Strategic Partnerships, Key Account Management, or Enterprise Sales.
  • Proven track record of managing complex sales and negotiation cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience negotiating high-value commercial agreements and strategic partnerships.
  • Strong experience managing executive-level relationships.
  • Excellent analytical and commercial acumen.

title: Supervisor de Loja - Shopping Pátio Batel
description:
Descrição da vaga

Que tal entrar para o nosso ?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Esta convocação é para você, que tem garra e paixão por vencer e quer assumir uma posição peça-chave do nosso time, afinal, a loja tem que estar organizada para o jogo acontecer.

Sua missão será liderar e desenvolver a equipe de vendas, garantindo a excelência no atendimento e a performance comercial, de acordo com o posicionamento premium da loja. Atuar como elo entre a gerência e os consultores de vendas, impulsionando resultados e promovendo uma experiência diferenciada para o cliente.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Gestão de Equipe:
  • Acompanhar e direcionar a equipe de vendas no dia a dia.
  • Realizar feedbacks, orientar sobre técnicas de vendas e comportamento no atendimento.
  • Apoiar o processo de integração e treinamento de novos vendedores.
  • Gestão Comercial:
  • Monitorar indicadores como ticket médio, conversão e itens por atendimento.
  • Garantir que metas individuais e coletivas sejam atingidas.
  • Sugerir ações de vendas, campanhas e abordagens para diferentes perfis de clientes.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente:
  • Atuar no atendimento quando necessário, reforçando o padrão de excelência.
  • Resolver ocorrências e reclamações com rapidez e empatia.
  • Operacional:
  • Apoiar a organização e manutenção do layout e exposição dos produtos conforme o VM.
  • Garantir que a equipe siga os processos operacionais e políticas da loja.

Requisitos:

  • Formação: Ensino médio completo (superior em andamento é diferencial)
  • Conhecimentos: Técnicas de vendas, gestão de indicadores, CRM, pacote Office básico.
  • Diferenciais: Vivência em varejo premium ou esportivo, conhecimento em omnichannel.

Informações adicionais

SOBRE A CENTAURO

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

SOBRE NÓS

Nós somos a Centauro, uma empresa do Grupo SBF.

Queremos ser reconhecidos na sociedade como a marca que movimenta o mercado esportivo para um novo patamar, contribuindo com o aumento da atividade física no Brasil. Estamos presentes em 26 estados, com 226 lojas próprias espalhadas pelo Brasil.

Somos convictos, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas pela força da nossa essência.

Somos fazedores, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas com ações práticas.

Somos saudavelmente inconformados, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas a fazerem mais e melhor.

Somos criadores, acreditamos que sendo curiosos e tendo sede pelo novo, vamos criar o que ainda não foi feito.

Movimentar é o nosso esporte

title: Quality Manager
description:
About ROHA

From one small office in India in 1972 to a leading Multinational Company, engaged in Manufacture and Marketing of colors and food ingredients, ROHA today has offices in 22 countries, 14 technical application labs in many time zones globally. Manufacturing facilities are spread out across 14 countries: US, UK, Spain, Italy, India, South Africa, Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand, China, Egypt, Brazil, Mexico & Australia. ROHA's products are marketed in more than 130 countries. Its portfolio includes natural extracts (oleoresins, juices and concentrates), an exclusive range of synthetic colors for the cosmetics and household goods industries, industrial colors, and animal feed additives.

We are hiring Quality Manager

Looking candidates from FOOD INDUSTRY ONLY

Candidates must be based in or near Itaquaquecetuba

Opportunity for Mid Management Level

5 days Working

Reporting to Regional Quality Manager

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, including laboratory technicians.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain quality policies, procedures, and systems in accordance with GMP, HACCP, and food safety standards.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian and international regulatory requirements applicable to food color manufacturing.
  • Oversee testing of raw materials, in-process materials, and finished products.
  • Review and approve product specifications, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), and finished product releases.
  • Develop, review, and maintain laboratory Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and testing methodologies.
  • Monitor laboratory and production compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
  • Manage preventive maintenance and calibration programs for laboratory equipment.
  • Investigate quality issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Partner with Production to troubleshoot process and quality-related issues.
  • Lead internal, customer, certification, and third-party audits, ensuring timely responses to audit findings.
  • Manage customer quality questionnaires and provide technical support and product application guidance.
  • Support new product development and identify opportunities for R&D projects.
  • Coordinate product recall activities when required.
  • Ensure all QA/QC documentation is complete, accurate, and compliant.
  • Develop, mentor, and train quality personnel while promoting a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Prepare quality metrics and reports for executive leadership.

title: Especialista de Serviços - Equipamentos Elétricos
description:
A LiuGong Latin America está em busca de um(a) Especialista de Serviços – Equipamentos Elétricos para integrar nossa equipe.

Sobre a LiuGong Latin America

A LiuGong Latin America (LGLA) foi fundada no Brasil em 2008 e é uma subsidiária integral do Grupo LiuGong. Desde 2015 fabricando equipamentos no país, a LiuGong vem crescendo nos mercados brasileiro e latino-americano. O negócio abrange a venda e manutenção de equipamentos e acessórios para máquinas de construção, soluções de financiamento, treinamento de clientes, consultoria técnica e outros escopos.

Os principais produtos incluem carregadeiras de rodas, escavadeiras, motoniveladoras, rolos compactadores, retroescavadeiras, caminhões rígidos e plataformas aéreas de trabalho. Além disso, a LiuGong continua desenvolvendo a estrutura de sua fábrica e centro de treinamento localizado na cidade de Mogi Guaçu, além de escritórios comerciais em Campinas e Belo Horizonte, fortalecendo o corpo de profissionais e qualificando o portfólio de produtos.

Para saber mais sobre a LiuGong:

  • Site Global: LiuGong Global
  • Site América Latina: LiuGong Latin America

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e analisar materiais técnicos voltados ao suporte de equipamentos elétricos para construção.
  • Atuar na identificação, análise e reporte de falhas de campo, trabalhando em conjunto com a engenharia de produto global para definição de soluções técnicas.
  • Suportar tecnicamente a rede de distribuidores e áreas internas como Comercial, Peças, Marketing, Produção e Vendas.
  • Participar dos processos de análise e julgamento de garantia.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), qualidade de produto, registros de máquinas e ocorrências de campo.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente negociações comerciais e projetos estratégicos da companhia.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e análises de desempenho dos produtos.
  • Ministrar treinamentos técnicos para distribuidores e equipes internas.
  • Acompanhar programas de demonstração de produtos, buscando otimização de performance e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas técnicos em campo.
  • Avaliar novas tecnologias do mercado em conjunto com as áreas de produto.
